items.title: La IA plantea nuevos retos para el suministro de agua por su creciente demanda de electricidad
items.author: Todd Woody, Mark Chediak
items.summary: Existe el riesgo de que el rápido crecimiento de los centros de datos intensifique el impacto de las sequías y las olas de calor provocadas por el cambio climático, que ya están generando presión sobr ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los desarrolladores de centros de datos han comenzado a promocionar nuevas tecnologías que reducen drásticamente la cantidad de agua necesaria para refrigerar servidores que se calientan en lugares afectados por la sequía, como Arizona. Sin embargo, estos esfuerzos no abordan la gran mayoría del consumo de agua derivado del desarrollo de la IA. A kilómetros de distancia de la proliferación de centros de datos, las centrales eléctricas consumen ahora enormes volúmenes de agua para generar la electricidad necesaria para el funcionamiento de la inteligencia artificial, incluidos los sistemas de refrigeración más eficientes. Nuevas investigaciones indican que este consumo indirecto de agua está creciendo rápidamente. En un estudio reciente, investigadores de la Universidad de Michigan estimaron que el agua utilizada fuera de las instalaciones aumentaría el consumo anual total de tres grandes centros de datos de IA planificados para el estado en 14.000 millones de galones. “Se ha prestado mucha menos atención a este uso indirecto del agua, a pesar de que a menudo es significativamente mayor que el uso directo y tiene repercusiones en las cuencas hidrográficas y los recursos hídricos regionales”, dijo Shaolei Ren , profesor de la Universidad de California en Riverside que estudia el consumo de agua de los centros de datos . En Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ), uno de los pocos desarrolladores que divulga públicamente el consumo indirecto de agua, dicho uso representó aproximadamente el 96% de los 21.000 millones de galones (80.000 millones de litros) de agua que la empresa consumió en 2024, lo que supone un aumento de casi el 120% con respecto a 2021, según su último informe de sostenibilidad . El 4% restante se utilizó en las instalaciones, principalmente en los centros de datos, que representan casi la totalidad del consumo eléctrico de Meta. “La transparencia es un pilar fundamental del programa de gestión del agua de Meta”, declaró un portavoz en un correo electrónico. Según los investigadores, los centros de datos de IA con alta capacidad de procesamiento pueden consumir hasta 10 veces más electricidad que las instalaciones convencionales, y la mayor parte de esa energía se necesita para alimentar los servidores. Para generar esa electricidad, las centrales eléctricas de combustibles fósiles y nucleares necesitan grandes cantidades de agua para producir el vapor que impulsa las turbinas. En todo Estados Unidos, una creciente oposición ha puesto de relieve la preocupación por el impacto ambiental local y el aumento de las facturas de electricidad. Esta oposición ha provocado moratorias y otras restricciones. Según la firma de investigación Data Center Watch, al menos 45 proyectos valorados en casi US$68.000 millones fueron bloqueados o retrasados entre abril y junio. Existe el riesgo de que el rápido crecimiento de los centros de datos intensifique el impacto de las sequías y las olas de calor provocadas por el cambio climático, que ya están generando presión sobre los suministros de agua en muchos lugares. “La demanda de centros de datos se está disparando y lo cierto es que las instalaciones de energía y agua no podrán satisfacerla”, afirmó Kerri Hickenbottom, profesora asociada de ingeniería en la Universidad de Arizona que investiga el consumo de agua en los centros de datos. Las estimaciones del consumo anual indirecto de agua de los centros de datos estadounidenses oscilan entre los 211.000 millones de galones (800.000 millones de litros) según un estudio del Laboratorio Nacional Lawrence Berkeley de 2024 y hasta 4 billones de galones, según un análisis reciente de la organización ambiental sin fines de lucro Ceres. Esto equivale a abastecer entre 2 y casi 37 millones de hogares estadounidenses promedio al año. Según los desarrolladores, una de las razones de la falta de transparencia es que no existe un protocolo estándar para calcular el consumo indirecto de agua en los centros de datos. “Necesitamos un consenso en el sector si queremos informar colectivamente sobre el consumo indirecto de agua”, declaró Brandon Oyer, director de energía y agua de Amazon Web Services. Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) anunció que la eficiencia hídrica en sus centros de datos ha mejorado un 52 % desde 2021, en parte gracias a la implementación de sistemas de refrigeración que requieren menos agua y a la tecnología que reduce el calor dentro de las instalaciones. “Esto permite mantener el consumo de agua, tanto dentro como fuera de las instalaciones, lo más bajo posible”, afirmó Will Hewes, responsable de sostenibilidad hídrica de Amazon Web Services. Ben Townsend, director de estrategia de infraestructura y sostenibilidad de Google ( GOOGL ), afirmó que la compañía actualmente no informa sobre el consumo indirecto de agua, sino que se ha centrado en alimentar sus centros de datos con energía renovable. “Con la energía eólica, solar y el almacenamiento, estos proyectos tienen una huella hídrica prácticamente nula”, declaró. Estas soluciones se están poniendo a prueba en zonas críticas de centros de datos afectadas por la sequía, como Arizona, donde el agua es un factor crítico debido a la sequía del río Colorado y sus embalses. En agosto, el gobierno federal anunció un recorte del 27 % en la asignación de agua para Arizona, con la posibilidad de recortes mucho más severos si las condiciones continúan deteriorándose. Los centros de datos del estado se concentran en el área de Phoenix, donde las ciudades dependen del río para entre el 20 % y el 50 % de su suministro de agua . Según las predicciones de Bloomberg Intelligence, los proyectos de centros de datos de IA que se están construyendo actualmente en Arizona podrían disparar la demanda de agua in situ a 5.000 millones de galones anuales en los próximos años, lo que representa el 4,5 % de la producción anual actual de agua de Phoenix. Sin embargo, según los investigadores, el consumo indirecto de agua sería muchísimo mayor. Michael Gertzman, portavoz del Departamento de Servicios de Agua de Phoenix, explicó que un solicitante para un gran centro de datos debe revelar su consumo estimado de agua en el sitio. El uso indirecto de agua no forma parte de la evaluación. Ante la sequía récord de 26 años que azota el suroeste de Estados Unidos, y con temperaturas máximas diarias promedio de 42 °C (108 °F) en Phoenix durante los últimos años, los desarrolladores de centros de datos están recurriendo a tecnologías que requieren poca o ninguna agua en las instalaciones, como los sistemas de refrigeración por aire. Sin embargo, esto conlleva ciertas desventajas, ya que la eliminación de ese calor requiere electricidad. Un estudio de 2025 , del que Hickenbottom fue coautor, señaló que en el área de Phoenix, el consumo indirecto de agua de los sistemas que utilizan enfriadoras refrigeradas por aire puede ser más de 2,5 veces mayor que el de las enfriadoras refrigeradas por agua, que utilizan más agua in situ. Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ), que opera varios centros de datos en Arizona, no proporcionó datos sobre su consumo indirecto de agua ni indicó si calcula dicho consumo. La compañía afirmó haber reducido en un 90% la cantidad de agua necesaria en sus instalaciones por kilovatio-hora utilizado en sus centros de datos desde principios de la década de 2000. Espera ahorrar 33 millones de galones (125 millones de litros) anuales en cada una de sus instalaciones gracias a los sistemas de refrigeración líquida. “Nuestro objetivo es minimizar el consumo de agua directamente en las comunidades donde operamos, al tiempo que mantenemos diseños de centros de datos altamente eficientes y colaboramos con las empresas de servicios públicos para satisfacer nuestras necesidades energéticas de forma responsable”, declaró un portavoz de Microsoft en un correo electrónico. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert touts successes as tenure winds down
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: With her tenure as WNBA commissioner in its final months, Cathy Engelbert met with media prior to Game 1 of the WNBA Finals in San Francisco on Saturday and touted the league's unprecedented popularity in recent years -- but also warned of headaches that can come with such rapid growth and prosperity.
items.body:
With her tenure as WNBA commissioner in its final months, Cathy Engelbert met with media prior to Game 1 of the WNBA Finals in San Francisco on Saturday and touted the league's unprecedented popularity in recent years -- but also warned of headaches that can come with such rapid growth and prosperity.
And she began her remarks using the Finals itself as one of the biggest signs of the league's success in the last couple of years as it reached once-imaginable milestones in terms of revenue and popularity.
The Golden State Valkyries, an expansion team just one season ago, hosted the Atlanta Dream for Game 1 of a Finals that will crown a first-time champion regardless of who wins.
"To be hosting a WNBA Finals in just your second season is remarkable," said Engelbert, who took over as commissioner in 2019 and has announced she will retire at the end of the calendar year.
Perhaps even more remarkable is another first the franchise achieved in the spring, when outlets including CNBC and Inc. valued the franchise at $1 billion -- the first time a women's pro sports franchise ever reached that mark.
Other achievements Engelbert highlighted included:
-- A centralized replay center, which Engelbert first announced at the All-Star Game in Chicago in July, remains on track to be fully operational for the start of next season. The center, in Secaucus, N.J., "will give our officials access to state-of-the-art technology and the best available camera angles, helping us bring greater consistency, efficiency and accuracy to our officiating process," Engelbert said.
-- In the first year of the league's new collective-bargaining agreement, the WNBA reached more than 90 million unique viewers in the United States, who watched more than 320 million hours of content, Engelbert said. A record 51 telecasts averaged 1 million or more viewers (last season saw 19 such games).
-- Engelbert said the league's social and digital platforms generated more than 4 billion views. "Never thought I would be standing up here talking in billions for the W, but we're there," she said.
-- Nearly 3.8 million people attended games across the league this season, also a new record mark for the league. "We averaged a record 11,500 fans per game and almost two-thirds of our regular-season games were sellouts," the 61-year-old former Deloitte CEO said.
-- While the Valkyries are playing in their second season of existence, the league also welcomed in a pair of expansion teams this season in the Portland Fire and Toronto Tempo -- the league's first team based outside the United States. Three more franchises are slated to join the league in the coming years: Cleveland (2028) and Detroit (2029) will have new teams after having previous WNBA franchises, and Philadelphia will begin play in 2030.
And players have experienced unprecedented financial gains, as well, including charter flights, minimum salaries under the new CBA ($270,000) that are more than supermax contracts under the previous CBA and top-end contracts reaching nearly $1.5 million per year.
But after talking about the league's successes in recent years, Engelbert was asked about any regrets she has, particularly as the increase in the league's popularity and financial success led to contentious CBA negotiations.
"The one thing you learn when you get in these big jobs, like I ran a firm of 100,000 people (at Deloitte), not everybody is going to like you or agree with your strategy perhaps," Engelbert said, before adding, "I think you just saw from the players who made the All-Star this year, the players who made kind of some of these end-of-season award teams and I have talked to many of them to let them know that they won, they are all so bullish on the future of the league.
"I think in collective bargaining, yes, there was a lot of contentiousness. But again, if you talk to a lot of people who do collective bargaining negotiations, they are saying, ‘Cathy, that means you've arrived as a league because if you didn't have that contentiousness, neither side would have felt like they won.'"
--Field Level Media

items.title: Antofagasta's Centinela strike ends after deal with unions
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Workers from two unions at Chile's Centinela copper mine have ratified an agreement reached with Antofagasta Minerals on a new collective bargaining contract, ending a strike of more than a week, the unions and the company said on Sunday.
items.body:
Workers from two unions at Chile's Centinela copper mine have ratified an agreement reached with Antofagasta Minerals on a new collective bargaining contract, ending a strike of more than a week, the unions and the company said on Sunday.
More than 700 members of the Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions [USN:L1N45T0DW TEXT:"began the strike"] on October 7 after contract talks broke down. They had sought equal benefits for workers regardless of which union they belonged to.
The parties [USN:L1N45Z0OK TEXT:"returned to the negotiating table"] on Tuesday in an effort to resolve the dispute.
"The Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions announce the successful conclusion of our collective bargaining process, after 94.49% of participating workers voted to approve the proposed collective agreement," the unions said in a statement, which was followed by a company statement confirming the deal.
Three workers had been on a hunger strike in an effort to pressure both sides into finding a solution to the deadlocked talks.
Antofagasta said on Wednesday it had managed to maintain production at normal levels, avoiding any negative impact from the strike at the mine, which produced 240,400 metric tons of copper in 2025.
The strike at Centinela, along with the ultimately unrealized risk of a supervisors' strike at BHP's Escondida mine, had been supporting global copper prices amid concerns about the industry's ability to increase supply sufficiently to meet expected future demand.

items.title: Figueroa withdraws from Kameda fight due to illness after losing WBA featherweight title
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brandon Figueroa withdrew from his fight against Tomoki Kameda on Saturday, a day after he was stripped of his WBA featherweight title for failing to make weight.
items.body:
Brandon Figueroa withdrew from his fight against Tomoki Kameda on Saturday, a day after he was [USN:L4N46300D TEXT:"stripped of his WBA featherweight title"] for failing to make weight.
On Friday, Figueroa lost his title after hitting the scales at 1.4 pounds over the 126-pound weight limit.
The fight had been set to proceed with Kameda eligible to clinch the belt if he won in Las Vegas and the title remaining vacant if Figueroa won, but the American boxer withdrew on the day of the bout.
"The previously scheduled Brandon Figueroa vs Tomoki Kameda bout is now off after Figueroa fell ill overnight," Figueroa's promoters and event organisers Premier Boxing Champions said in a statement.
Japan's Kameda voiced his frustration in a post on social media.
"I trained hard in Mexico for about two and a half months, starting in late July, and I was ready to step into the ring in the best possible condition," the 35-year-old wrote.
"However, this is not the end. I have agreed with the promoter and the WBA that I will be given priority for the next WBA featherweight championship decider.
"I will firmly switch my mindset, and I will start from the beginning and train again for what comes next. I will definitely win the world champion's belt."
In the main event on Saturday, Sebastian Fundora stopped Ermal Hadribeaj in the 12th round to defend his WBC super welterweight title.

items.title: Bruins win fifth straight, extend Kings' winless start
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: David Pastrnak and Marat Khusnutdinov each had a goal and an assist for the visiting Boston Bruins in a 4-1 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.
items.body:
David Pastrnak and Marat Khusnutdinov each had a goal and an assist for the visiting Boston Bruins in a 4-1 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.
Elias Lindholm and JJ Peterka scored empty-net goals, and Jeremy Swayman made 25 saves for the Bruins, who have won five in a row, including a 4-2 win at the Anaheim Ducks on Friday night.
Alex Laferriere scored and Anton Forsberg made 24 saves for the Kings, who fell to 0-4-2. Los Angeles' winless start is its longest since opening the 1984-85 season with a 0-6-3 record.
Khusnutdinov scored the go-ahead goal at 13:36 of the third period before the Bruins tacked on two empty-netters.
Khusnutdinov's goal was set up after Morgan Geekie took a wrist shot off the rush from the left circle that hit Forsberg up high. He was unable to cover the rebound before the puck ended up in the crease, where Khusnutdinov pushed it across the goal line for a 2-1 lead.
Lindholm scored into an empty net during 5-on-4 play with 1:58 remaining to make it 3-1, and Peterka hit the empty net with 18 seconds left for a 4-1 lead.
The Kings, who have been held to one goal in each of their past four games, scored their lone goal 31 seconds into the game.
Swayman was handcuffed by Laferriere's tip off a point shot and the rebound came out to the bottom of the left circle. Adrian Kempe skated in and made a touch pass to Laferriere in front of the crease, and he pushed the puck past Swayman for a 1-0 lead.
The Bruins tied it 1-1 at 2:43 of the second.
Joel Armia was in the Kings' offensive zone when he tried to make a pass back to defenseman Erik Gustafsson at the left point, but the puck got under Gustafsson's stick.
Pastrnak sped by Gustafsson and reached the puck first to start a breakaway. Brandt Clarke was closing fast on Pastrnak when he took a wrist shot from the top of the right circle that beat Forsberg on the far side.
Pastrnak had scored his 423rd goal with Boston on Friday, moving past Brad Marchand for sole possession of fourth place in team history.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ex-Chihuahua attorney general accused of treason for allowing US participation in drug raid
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Mexican authorities arrested former Chihuahua Attorney General Cesar Jauregui on suspicion of treason after an investigation found he may have allowed foreign personnel to participate in operations reserved exclusively for national security forces, Attorney General Ernestina Godoy said on Saturday.
items.body:
Mexican authorities arrested former Chihuahua Attorney General Cesar Jauregui on suspicion of treason after an investigation found he may have allowed foreign personnel to participate in operations reserved exclusively for national security forces, Attorney General Ernestina Godoy said on Saturday.
Prosecutors allege Jauregui allowed US agents to participate in an "irregular" raid on a suspected drug laboratory in April in the northern border state of Chihuahua without the authorization required under Mexican law.
[USN:L4N4162EQ TEXT:"The US acknowledged"] in April that two employees of its embassy in Mexico City had died, without disclosing which agency they worked for. Sources familiar with the matter said the two were CIA officers involved in anti-narcotics efforts.
The deaths rekindled sensitivities around US involvement in Mexican security operations. In the immediate aftermath, President Claudia Sheinbaum had sought to de-escalate tensions, reiterating that her government welcomes intelligence sharing and bilateral cooperation against organized crime but does not permit US agents or forces to participate directly in operations on Mexican territory.
"The investigation determined that Cesar N may have engaged in conduct that could possibly constitute the crime of treason in matters of national security because he allegedly allowed foreign individuals to intervene without authorization on Mexican territory and take part in actions that correspond exclusively to national security forces," Godoy said in a video message on Saturday.
Mexican authorities identified the suspect as "Cesar N," following the common practice of withholding a suspect's full surname during criminal proceedings.
The arrest warrant was signed by a federal judge, Godoy said, adding that it came after months of investigations.
Jauregui could not immediately be reached for comment and the US embassy declined to comment on Saturday.

items.title: Trabajadores de mina chilena Centinela ratifican nuevo contrato; cesa huelga
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos en huelga de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela ratificaron el preacuerdo logrado entre el sindicato y Antofagasta Minerals para un nuevo contrato colectivo, con lo que se pone fin a una huelga de más de una semana en el yacimiento, dijo el domingo la agrupación gremial.
items.body:
Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos en huelga de la mina chilena de cobre Centinela ratificaron el preacuerdo logrado entre el sindicato y Antofagasta Minerals para un nuevo contrato colectivo, con lo que se pone fin a una huelga de más de una semana en el yacimiento, dijo el domingo la agrupación gremial.
Los más de 700 socios de Distrito Centinela y Minera Esperanza iniciaron el paro el 7 de octubre tras fracasar el diálogo contractual, donde pedían que los trabajadores tengan los mismos beneficios independientemente del sindicato al pertenezcan.
Pero días atrás volvieron a la mesa de diálogo en un intento por encontrar una salida al conflicto.
"Con profunda emoción y orgullo, los sindicatos Distrito Centinela y Minera Esperanza informamos el exitoso término de nuestra negociación colectiva, luego de que el 94,49% de los trabajadores que participaron en la votación aprobara la propuesta de contrato colectivo", dijo el sindicato en un comunicado.
"Hemos conquistado la mayoría de nuestras exigencias acerca de igualdad y equidad, poniendo fin a años de diferencias e injusticias entre trabajadores de una misma compañía minera", agregó.
Tres trabajadores habían mantenido una huelga de hambre en un intento por presionar una solución a las estancadas conversaciones entre las partes.
Antofagasta afirmó en la semana que ha logrado sostener su producción en niveles normales lo que evitado los efectos negativos de la paralización. En 2025, Centinela produjo 240.400 toneladas de cobre.
Además argumentó que durante los últimos días había presentado nuevas propuestas con materias relevantes y una mejora significativa en las condiciones económicas.
La huelga en Centinela, además del riesgo finalmente no consumado de paralización de supervisores en Escondida, de BHP, ha estado apoyando los precios globales del cobre en medio de los temores sobre la dificultad de impulsar la oferta para abastecer el consumo estimado hacia adelante.

items.title: Rubio says Trump to take up to 60 days to weigh Russia sanctions
items.author: Nandita Bose, Gram Slattery
items.creator: Nandita Bose, Gram Slattery
items.summary: The waiver comes just weeks before November's midterm elections, with Trump under pressure over high energy prices as war with Iran disrupts global oil supplies.
items.body:
The day after waiving sanctions and tariffs related to Russian exports, US President Donald Trump said on Saturday he has yet to announce a final decision on the matter as Secretary of State Marco Rubio said officials want more time to evaluate the situation.
Rubio said on Saturday that the president will use up to 60 days to assess the economic impact of Russia-related sanctions and tariffs that he waived a day earlier.
"A lot of you don't know what my decision is yet, but we'll figure it out, and you'll figure it out," Trump told reporters at his Mar-a-Lago club in Palm Beach, Florida.
The waiver comes just weeks before November's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], with Trump under pressure over high energy prices as war with Iran disrupts global oil supplies.
Trump signed an executive order on Friday waiving key sanctions and tariffs under the law known as the Graham Act, which he signed last month at the urging of lawmakers who want to pressure Moscow over its war in Ukraine.
The measures, including tariffs on Russian goods and penalties on countries buying Russian oil and gas, were due to take effect next week. Friday's order did not specify how long the waiver would last, but Rubio said Trump opted for a 60-day review.
"I think the president wants to take the 60-day period of time to sort of analyze what imposing both sanctions and tariffs will mean to the global economy and even to the US economy," Rubio told reporters before boarding a plane for a trip to Uzbekistan.
Complicating matters is the Graham Act's call not only for sanctions on Russia but also for tariffs on goods from countries that import Russian energy supplies. Rubio pointed to India, an important US partner that has diversified its energy supplies but remains heavily dependent on Russian oil.
Friday's executive order [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"drew criticism"] from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, who warned it would embolden Russian President Vladimir Putin and prolong the war.
Senator Darline Graham, a South Carolina Republican whose late brother Lindsey Graham championed the legislation that bears his name, said she disagreed with Trump's decision and planned to discuss it with him when he campaigns for her next week.
"Personally, I would choose to keep the pressure on Russia," she told reporters on Saturday. "Because I don't trust Putin and I don't trust Russia."
DIESEL SUPPLIES Rubio also defended a separate US agreement with Russia to increase diesel supplies to global markets, aimed at easing fuel prices that have climbed amid the war with Iran and disruptions to energy supplies.
Under the agreement, Trump said Russia initially would supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to the United States, followed by shipments in November and beyond.
"That diesel is going to be sold one way or the other," Rubio said. "The only difference is how much of it the United States was going to get."
Rubio said the diesel deal and sanctions waiver reflected the challenge of managing conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine that have disrupted global energy supplies.
"These conflicts around the world are starting to crash into each other," he said.

items.title: Jonathan Aranda's 3-hit night leads Rays past Guardians, ties ALCS 2-2
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: CLEVELAND -- Jonathan Aranda knew it was inevitable that Junior Caminero, Yandy Diaz and he would heat up at the plate for the Tampa Bay Rays.
items.body:
CLEVELAND -- Jonathan Aranda knew it was inevitable that Junior Caminero, Yandy Diaz and he would heat up at the plate for the Tampa Bay Rays.
They collectively did so on Saturday in Game 4 of the American League Championship Series, allowing the Rays to pull even with the Cleveland Guardians at two wins apiece in the best-of-seven series with a 7-3 victory.
Aranda had three hits, drove in two and scored the go-ahead run on Caminero's sixth-inning double, and Diaz belted a two-run homer as the trio combined to go 6-for-14 with four runs and five RBIs.
It is now guaranteed that the ALCS will return to St. Petersburg, Fla., for Game 6 on Monday. Game 5 will be played Sunday in Cleveland.
"To be honest, I felt like I was connecting with the ball the first couple of games, but just wasn't getting the hits," said Aranda, who was 0-for-10 in the first three contests against the Guardians. "In the postseason, there isn't time to get down on yourself.
"It was just a matter of time for us to get going. Now, we can use this going forward."
In the first three games, the Rays' talented trio managed just five hits in 34 at-bats.
Caminero doubled sharply to score Aranda in the sixth and give Tampa Bay a 2-1 advantage against Daniel Espino (0-1). The Rays tacked on three runs in the seventh, two of them on Aranda's single to right that Chase DeLauter misplayed for an error.
Aranda came around for his second run on Chandler Simpson's sacrifice fly off Slade Cecconi later in the seventh, extending the Rays' lead to 5-1. Yandy Diaz added a two-run homer in the ninth off Matt Festa to push Tampa Bay's advantage to 7-3.
"I'm very happy for this group, and we'll be ready to go tomorrow," Caminero said. "I just enjoy the moment and enjoy the game. Everyone knows me, everyone knows who I am and everyone gives me support."
Nick Martinez (1-0) pitched 5 1/3 strong innings for the win, allowing one run on two hits for AL East champion Tampa Bay. The right-hander struck out three and walked two, retiring 11 straight batters between the first and fifth innings.
AL Central champion Cleveland pulled within 5-3 in the bottom of the seventh with a pair of runs against Ian Seymour. Travis Bazzana hit a solo homer and Brayan Rocchio later singled in Patrick Bailey, all with two outs.
"This is the ALCS, we obviously would have loved to have taken tonight," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said. "But we still have a three-game series ahead of us against a really good team. And I anticipate it going down to the wire."
DeLauter gave the Guardians a 1-0 lead with a single in the first, bringing home Steven Kwan. Cleveland had failed to score in 13 innings against Martinez in the regular season, losing twice in two games.
The Rays tied it at 1-1 in the third on Aranda's two-out single off Foster Griffin, scoring Diaz. Tampa Bay didn't have a hit in its first time through the order, but leadoff batter Diaz doubled in his second at-bat.
"They're just good hitters, so it was only a matter of time," said Griffin, who gave up one run in 3 2/3 innings as the bulk reliever. "They hit a couple of balls hard and a couple balls that weren't hit as hard, but fell through. But that's baseball and we'll move on to tomorrow."
Guardians star Jose Ramirez went 0-for-3 with a walk, extending his on-base streak to 16 postseason games and tying the Cleveland franchise record.
The first-pitch temperature was 46 degrees. One night earlier, Cleveland experienced its first-ever postseason home rainout.
--Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

items.title: Blaze at St Petersburg oil sites as Kyiv launches drones at Russia
items.summary: Ukrainian attacks set an oil export terminal ablaze in St. Petersburg on Sunday, as Kyiv launched more than 1,000 drones across Russia in one of its largest ever aerial bombardments.
items.body:
Home / World News / Blaze at St Petersburg oil sites as Kyiv launches drones at Russia

Blaze at St Petersburg oil sites as Kyiv launches drones at Russia The attack comes amid deepening tensions between Ukraine and Washington, with U.S. President Donald Trump criticizing Kyiv for its strikes on Russian oil infrastructure

Plumes of smoke rise from fires (centre) at an oil refinery following what the authorities say is a Ukrainian drone strike in the course of the Russia-Ukraine conflict | REUTERS

AP Moscow 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 18 2026 | 4:03 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Ukrainian attacks set an oil export terminal ablaze in St. Petersburg on Sunday, as Kyiv launched more than 1,000 drones across Russia in one of its largest ever aerial bombardments.
The attack comes amid deepening tensions between Ukraine and Washington, with U.S. President Donald Trump criticizing Kyiv for its strikes on Russian oil infrastructure.
One person was killed and five more were wounded in the attack, which sparked fires at both the Petersburg Oil Terminal and the city's Ruchi oil depot, said local Gov. Alexander Beglov. A logistics center belonging to Russian retailer Ozon and a data center for local tech giant VK were also targeted, both companies confirmed.
 

Russia's Ministry of Defense said Sunday that its forces had destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 Russian regions, as well as the annexed Ukrainian peninsula of Crimea and the Black Sea.
Meanwhile, a woman died and at least two other people were wounded, including a 6-year-old girl, after Russia launched two attacks on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia, local officials said.

Two apartment buildings, 18 cars and an educational institution were damaged as a result of the attack, head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration Mykhailo Semikin said.
Russia continues energy attacks, Kyiv says US President Donald Trump announced on Oct. 11 that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire" in the 4 1/2-year-old war, but offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

Ukraine confirmed Thursday it had resumed attacks on Russian oil after a three-day hiatus.
Zelenskyy was outraged by Russia's continuing aerial bombardment of his country's energy infrastructure in apparent defiance of Trump's demand on Sunday for both sides to halt those attacks. The Ukrainian government initially said that it was heeding the ceasefire.
In a post on X Sunday, Zelenskyy said that in the week since Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire, Russia had attacked Ukraine's energy, oil and gas sectors 76 times.
He also said that in the past night alone, energy facilities in four Ukrainian regions had been attacked and tens of thousands of families were still without power. He accused Russia of trying to cause a blackout.

"America should see that Russia is not taking any reciprocal steps in response to sanctions relief or agreements. On the contrary, they take every signal of an opportunity to make money as proof that their bet on war is paying off and they can keep fighting," he wrote.
Zelenskyy also stressed that the war was continuing due to Russia's invasion - not because Ukraine was defending itself.
"It is Russia that must face pressure for peace to have a chance. Thank you to everyone who understands this and helps," he said.

items.title: Walsh surprised by 50m freestyle short course world record
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: American Gretchen Walsh said she had surprised herself by bettering her own short course 50 metres freestyle world record, adding that she was hoping to go even quicker at the world championships in Beijing this year.
items.body:
American Gretchen Walsh said she had surprised herself by bettering her own short course 50 metres freestyle world record, adding that she was hoping to go even quicker at the world championships in Beijing this year.
Walsh's time of 22.75 seconds at the UVA SCM Pro Am in Charlottesville, Virginia on Friday saw her improve on her previous best mark of 22.83, set at the short-course world championships in Budapest in 2024.
"A lot has happened since then, a lot of accomplishments, so I think yesterday's world record meant a lot more (than the previous record)," four-time Olympic medallist Walsh told SwimSwam on Saturday.
"I've been training really, really well recently, and I think that I've been putting in really great work into the pool. So I knew that was going to pay off.
"But the goal is to be breaking world records and doing all of this good stuff at the world championships in December in Beijing. I wasn't expecting a world record. I was really happy with that swim, and I'm really looking forward to resting and being able to go faster than that."
In long-course swimming, Walsh owns the [USN:L4N41G023 TEXT:"100m butterfly record"] and was also part of world record-setting US teams in both the women's and mixed 4×100 m medley relays.

Walsh's time of 22.75 seconds at the UVA SCM Pro Am in Charlottesville, Virginia on Friday saw her improve on her previous best mark of 22.83, set at the short-course world championships in Budapest in 2024.
"A lot has happened since then, a lot of accomplishments, so I think yesterday's world record meant a lot more (than the previous record)," four-time Olympic medallist Walsh told SwimSwam on Saturday.
"I've been training really, really well recently, and I think that I've been putting in really great work into the pool. So I knew that was going to pay off.

items.title: Saudi-led coalition says helicopter crash in Najran kills two crew members
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A reconnaissance AH-6i helicopter crashed in the Najran region of Saudi Arabia, killing its two crew members, the Saudi-led coalition's spokesperson Major General Turki al-Maliki said in a statement on Sunday.
items.body:
A reconnaissance AH-6i helicopter crashed in the Najran region of Saudi Arabia, killing its two crew members, the Saudi-led coalition's spokesperson Major General Turki al-Maliki said in a statement on Sunday.
The helicopter crashed due to a technical malfunction in an area under the jurisdiction of the Saudi National Guard Ministry, the statement added.
Yemen's Houthis released footage later on Sunday of what they said was a Saudi AH-6i helicopter being shot down by a missile while carrying out what they described as hostile activities near Najran.
The footage did not clearly show the incident, and Reuters could not immediately verify the Houthis' claim. There was no immediate comment from Saudi authorities.
On Saturday, Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said on X that the group had shot down a Saudi Apache helicopter near Najran. It was not clear if that referred to the same incident.
Al-Maliki commented on Saree's post on Sunday with a photo of several Apaches lined up, saying: "You claim to have shot it down, but it will enter the battlefield soon."
Najran has been subject to attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis in recent weeks as fighting between the coalition and the Yemen-based militant group escalated, with the [USN:L1N4620VJ TEXT:"Yemen conflict"] becoming another front in the US-led war with Iran .

items.title: Highways ministry invokes catastrophic failure clause against 2 developers
items.summary: The Highways Ministry has invoked the newly introduced provision of the catastrophic failure clause against two highway developers for major structural failures on National Highways projects.
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / Highways ministry invokes catastrophic failure clause against 2 developers

Highways ministry invokes catastrophic failure clause against 2 developers The project was sanctioned for Rs 2,061 crore, and EPC work was awarded to the joint venture of VRC Constructions (India) Pvt Ltd and R & C Infra Engineers Pvt Ltd at a contract price of Rs 613 crore

Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 18 2026 | 3:41 PM IST

Listen to This Article

The Highways Ministry has invoked the newly introduced provision of the catastrophic failure clause against two highway developers for major structural failures on National Highways projects.
The provisions of the catastrophic event allow highway-owning agencies to bar highway developers for two years from bidding for new projects. Such highway builders also face negative ratings that will adversely impact their chances of getting future projects.
According to documents accessed by PTI, the Road Transport and Highways Ministry has notified a catastrophic event in a project comprising the four-lane Poondiankuppam-Sattanatharupam section of NH-45 (New NH-32) from km 67 to km 123 in Tamil Nadu under HAM mode.
  "The bid project cost was Rs 2,120 crore, and it was awarded to M/S Poonadinkuppam Sattanathapuram Section Private Limited (Promoters-M/s Oriental) under a concession agreement. The appointed date of the project was January 20, 2022, with a scheduled completion date of January 19, 2024.
"M/s Theme Engineering Services Private Limited has been appointed as the independent engineer," the ministry's order said.

The incident was accompanied by bulging, cracking and horizontal displacement of the reinforced earth.
In the second case, the project comprises the widening and strengthening of approximately 45 km of NH-727B from km 61.500 near Nawalpur to km 106.495 near Sikanderpur, to two -lane with paved shoulder/ four-lane with paved shoulder configuration under the engineering procurement and construction (EPC) mode in Uttar Pradesh.
The project was sanctioned for Rs 2,061 crore, and EPC work was awarded to the joint venture of VRC Constructions (India) Pvt Ltd and R & C Infra Engineers Pvt Ltd at a contract price of Rs 613 crore.
Technocrats Advisory Services Pvt Ltd had been appointed as the authority engineer for the project.
"An incident occurred on March 25, 2026, at about 1015 hours during the execution of reinforcement works for the viaduct portion of the major bridge over River Ghaghra at Chainage km 77+220.
"During the lifting and erection of the reinforcement cage for the viaduct pier, a portion of the cage collapsed and fell on workers present at the site, resulting in two fatalities and grievous injury to one person," the order document said.

items.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、第1シードのズベレフ準決勝敗退
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［上海（中国）　１７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［上海（中国）　１７日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのマスターズ上海大会は１７日、シングルス準決勝を行い、第１シードのアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）は敗退した。

今季を世界ランキング１位で終えることが確定しているズベレフは第２５シードのアレハンドロ・ダビドビッチ・フォキナ（スペイン）に７─５、４─６、３─６で逆転負け。３６本のウィナーを打たれて２時間２分で屈し、同選手との８回目の直接対決で２敗目を喫した。

ダビドビッチ・フォキナはマスターズ１０００では準優勝に終わった２０２２年のマスターズ・モンテカルロ大会以来となる、通算２回目の決勝進出を達成した。

準決勝のもう１試合では、第１２シードのラファエル・ホダル（スペイン）がロシア出身で第５シードの元世界ランク１位、ダニル・メドベージェフに６─３、６─４で勝利。大会史上最年少、２０歳で決勝進出を果たした。同選手がマスターズ１０００の決勝に進んだのはこれが初めて。

items.title: Predators show versatility in scoring for win over Blues
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Filip Forsberg scored his first goal of the season and added an assist for the Nashville Predators, who also scored on a penalty kill and a penalty shot in a 5-2 victory over the visiting St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.
items.body:
Filip Forsberg scored his first goal of the season and added an assist for the Nashville Predators, who also scored on a penalty kill and a penalty shot in a 5-2 victory over the visiting St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.
Jonathan Marchessault, Adam Edstrom, Ryan O'Reilly and Jack Drury also scored for the Predators. Steven Stamkos, Adam Wilsby and Roman Josi each recorded two assists.
Juuse Saros made 24 saves for Nashville, which snapped a three-game winless streak (0-1-2).
The Blues got goals from Philip Broberg and Jimmy Snuggerud. Mason McTavish, Jake Neighbours and Dylan Holloway added assists.
Jordan Binnington stopped 19 shots for the Blues, who lost their second straight.
St. Louis struck first thanks to a Predators turnover in their defensive end. McTavish kept Nashville from clearing the puck along the boards and fed Broberg, who notched his first of the season from the high slot with 13:39 left in the opening period.
Nashville tied it with 11:20 elapsed when Binnington was called for throwing his stick at Marchessault. That set up a penalty shot for the Predators forward, and he beat the Blues netminder through the legs.
That was the Predators' first penalty shot goal since Viktor Arvidsson scored one at Detroit on April 8, 2021. The Predators had missed their last seven.
Forsberg, a 40-goal scorer last season, entered Saturday with a team-leading 22 shots on goal. He finally broke his season-long drought on a wraparound off a pass from Stamkos with 7:38 left in the first period, giving Nashville a lead it would not relinquish.
Edstrom tallied his fourth goal and second short-handed goal of the season with 12:55 to go in the second period. However, Snuggerud responded 31 seconds later, snipping the Predators' lead back to one. St. Louis finished 1-for-5 on power play chances.
O'Reilly extended his goal-scoring streak to three when he backhanded in his own rebound less than three minutes into the third. Drury, acquired in June from Colorado, scored his first of the season with 11:46 remaining, deflecting Josi's cross-ice feed into the net.
--Field Level Media

items.title: サッカー＝バルセロナ5得点で圧勝、開幕から9戦全勝
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［セビリア（スペイン）　１７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［セビリア（スペイン）　１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は１７日、各地で試合を行い、首位バルセロナがベティスを５─２で下し、開幕９戦全勝とした。

バルセロナは前半１０分、右サイドで仕掛けたラミン・ヤマルがペナルティーエリア右端から左足で先制。２─１で迎えた後半６分にはヤマルのお膳立てからガブリエル・ジェズスが決めてリードを広げた。

対するベティスは同８分にエズ・アブデのゴールで１点差に詰め寄るも、その直後の小競り合いでファクンド・ベルナルがヤマルに頭突きを見舞ったとして退場処分となり、１０人での戦いを強いられた。バルセロナはその後、ヤマルのＦＫのこぼれ球をエリック・ガルシアが決めると、最後はダニ・オルモが締めくくった。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアは、ビルバオとスコアレスドロー。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出場はなかった。

その他、アトレチコ・マドリードはエスパニョールに１─０で勝利。ビリャレアルとエルチェはスコアレスドローに終わった。

９試合を終えて、バルセロナは勝ち点２７とし、２位アトレチコとの５ポイント差をキープ。ここまで計３９得点と圧倒的な強さを示している。

items.title: Cockroach protests pose fresh challenge for Modi govt amid voter roll row
items.summary: Opposition demands for Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over voter-roll revisions have put the government under pressure, as arrests and security restrictions risk fuelling wider protests ...
items.body:
Home / India News / Cockroach protests pose fresh challenge for Modi govt amid voter roll row

Cockroach protests pose fresh challenge for Modi govt amid voter roll row Opposition demands for Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over voter-roll revisions have put the government under pressure, as arrests and security restrictions risk fuelling wider protests

Supporters of the Cockroach Janta Party take part in a protest march in New Delhi | Image: Bloomberg

Bloomberg 7 min read Last Updated : Oct 18 2026 | 3:12 PM IST

Listen to This Article

By Shruti Srivastava and Sudhi Ranjan Sen
  Back in July, the resignation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s education minister swiftly ended India’s first major round of student “Cockroach” protests just as they were gaining momentum. This time, he has no easy way out. 
  Modi’s rivals are now demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging that he has failed to address criticism that a once-in-20-year update of India’s electoral rolls is unjustly purging millions of voters at the expense of the opposition. While there’s little hard evidence of bias, the furor was stoked by an Indian Express report last month that found Kumar ignored objections to the process raised by his two fellow commissioners. 
 

  Even if Modi wanted to get rid of Kumar, who has more than two years left on his term, the process would take time and political capital. The Election Commission of India is an independent body, and removing its head would require an investigation to prove “misbehavior” as well as approval by both houses of parliament in the same session with at least two-thirds of members present. 
  But Modi’s Bharatiya Janata Party has repeatedly backed the Election Commission and the revision of electoral rolls, which is intended to remove dead, duplicate and ineligible voters in the world’s largest democracy. A sudden U-turn to get rid of Kumar or halt the revision process would not only hand a victory to Modi’s opponents, but also call into question recent election wins for his party, which retains a dominant grip on parliament.

Also Read

Mass demonstrations in France spiral into worst violence in decades

Rioters loot stores, set fires in Italy during cost-of-living protest

CJP's Abhijeet Dipke granted conditional bail, asked to sign peace bond

Delhi Police files multiple FIRs over CJP's 'Lehra Do Tiranga' protest

Protests against CEC, SIR will continue despite interventions: Prakash Raj

  “Either you figure out a way of letting him step aside, or you ensure that the protests are delegitimized,” said Neelanjan Sircar, a political scientist at Ahmedabad University who specializes in Indian elections and voter behavior. “The government is very much on the back foot. But when you’re a dominant party with this kind of control, it can take a very long time for the slide to show.”
  The dynamics leave Modi little choice but to deploy repressive measures to snuff out the protests to avoid a repeat of July, when police bloodied thousands of students in street clashes near parliament in New Delhi. His government this time has opted for mass detentions, arrests of the Cockroach Janta Party’s leaders and a partial lockdown of the capital. 

  Central Delhi has effectively been turned into a fortress for over a week, with heavy security and restrictions on public assembly. Roads around one of the capital’s busiest commercial districts reopened on the weekend, though barricades remained in place and thousands of security personnel are deployed across the city. 
  The government has also stepped up its rhetoric against the protesters, painting them as a small minority seeking to overthrow the will of voters who have helped Modi’s BJP dominate Indian politics since 2014. Unlike the earlier protests related to exams, which resonated across the political spectrum and the wider public, the latest demonstrations are more led by the opposition INDIA alliance, which has struggled in recent elections. 

  “Attempts are being made to use the nation’s youth as pawns in a politics of chaos — some seek a regime change,” Defense Minister Rajnath Singh said in a national address on Friday. “Their struggle is not for electoral reform,” he added, accusing protesters of seeking to “dismantle democratic institutions and set the country ablaze.”
  The bet from Modi now is that the heavy security presence and arrests will help keep people off the streets long enough for the current wave of protests to fizzle out. The traffic gridlock and other inconveniences from the heightened restrictions also may increase public anger toward the protesters, particularly as the extent of disapproval over alleged election malpractices is still unclear.

  Home Minister Amit Shah has also used the issue to appeal to the BJP’s base of Hindu nationalists, who want to eliminate special provisions for religious minorities including Muslims. He has accused opponents of the voter-roll revision of supporting illegal immigration, signaling that the bulk of those removed from the list are foreigners from Muslim communities in neighboring countries such as Pakistan, Bangladesh and Myanmar, according to Nilanjan Mukhopadhyay, a New Delhi-based author and Modi biographer. 
  “I expect more draconian measures, including the use of laws against protesters and the opposition, over the next two years,” Mukhopadhyay said. “I also see a greater risk of communal tensions across the country, with minor confrontations potentially escalating into major incidents.”

  At the same time, the crackdown risks backfiring into a fresh rallying cry for young people, opposition parties and civil society groups. The spotlight again is quickly turning from a single issue to Modi’s government more broadly, at a time when inflation is rising and fresh graduates are struggling to find jobs as companies seek to deploy artificial intelligence to boost productivity. The rupee is hovering near record lows and foreign investors continue to sell Indian stocks. 
  While Kumar hasn’t explicitly referenced the calls to resign, the Election Commission has shown more responsiveness to public criticism of late. 
  Last month, it agreed to publish minutes of meetings, eased some voter-verification requirements, extended deadlines for voters to challenge their exclusions in Delhi and Maharashtra, and established a panel to review its voter-registration software. The poll body also said officials would collect documents from voters with unmatched or inconsistent records, while those excluded in earlier revisions could seek reinstatement.

  Modi’s best pathway to a swift resolution may come from another independent institution: The Supreme Court. 
  India’s top court, which previously allowed the voter-roll revision to continue, asked the poll body on Oct. 15 to respond to allegations that large numbers of eligible voters were removed from the lists. If judges order changes to the process, the government could point to the ruling rather than street pressure as the reason for a shift.
  “To me, the only viable option that is available now is for judiciary to step in and work toward negotiated solution which restores the credibility of the process,” said Mujibur Rehman, a Jamia Millia Islamia political scientist and author who has written extensively on Indian politics and political institutions.

  Even if that happens, the latest episode shows an even bigger problem: The Cockroach Janta Party has some staying power and isn’t going away easily. The pressure group, which has so far stayed out of electoral politics, has helped mobilize a street force that has given momentum to the INDIA opposition bloc in parliament and put Modi on the defensive.
  The next major tests at the polls is slated for early next year in Uttar Pradesh, India’s most populous state, which is crucial to any opposition hopes to unseat Modi’s government in the next national vote scheduled for 2029. So far Modi’s coalition government has shown no sign of breaking apart to potentially trigger an early election.

  The government is increasingly “anxious” about the cockroach movement, but it’s unclear if opposition parties will be able to convert the anger on the streets into votes at the ballot box, said Milan Vaishnav, director of the South Asia Program at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace and an expert on Indian electoral politics.
  “The real challenge is whether the INDIA alliance can translate this in electoral terms,” he said. “They are quite capable of snatching defeat from the jaws of victory."

items.title: フランスの大規模抗議デモが一部暴徒化、近年最悪の暴動に　生活費高騰に不満
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Janis Laizans　Stamos Prousalis 　Yann Tessier

[パリ １７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Janis Laizans　Stamos Prousalis 　Yann Tessier

[パリ １７日 ロイター] - フランス各地で１７日、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展した。

生活費の上昇を背景に、ベルギー、ポルトガル、イタリアでも同日、抗議デモが行われた。アルバニアでは、政府の腐敗への不満や雇用不足、教育水準の低さに抗議する人々が再び集まった。

フランスでは数十都市で数十万人が平和的に街頭行進する一方、一部の過激なグループが公共施設を標的にし、高級ブティックやスーパーマーケットを略奪し、警察車両や警官を襲撃した。

中部リモージュでは市庁舎が放火され、マルセイユでは黒ずくめのデモ参加者が市庁舎に乱入して無政府主義的な落書きをし、リヨンでは市の観光案内所が放火された。

ルコルニュ仏首相は、政府は暴力に「屈しない」と表明。騒乱は「極左」と犯罪者によるものだと非難した。

フランスでは２０２７年に大統領選が行われる予定で、同氏はＸに「この暴力を大統領選前の予行演習として利用しようとしている者たちに、はっきり言う。われわれは屈しない。誰であれ、暴力によって政治的な要求を押し付けることはできない」と投稿した。

同氏は夕方に現場を視察した際、抗議行動に関連して約１２００人を拘束したと述べた。

ヌニェス内相によると、全国のデモ参加者は約５５万人。仏労働総同盟（ＣＧＴ）はロイターに対し、参加者は８０万人と推計していると述べた。

マクロン大統領は、襲撃を実行した者を訴追し、処罰すると表明した。同氏はＸに「われわれの制度を損ない、平和的に要求を訴える人々を妨害することだけを狙う、混乱を引き起こす者たちに対し、われわれは一致団結して立ち向かう」と投稿した。

パリのデモ参加者、ローラさん（１９）は「私たちが声を上げているのは、生活費の負担があまりに重く、燃料価格が高すぎるからだ。高校生たちは、教員の増員やまともな学習環境を求めて抗議しているだけなのに、全国で暴力的な攻撃を受け、けがをしている」と語った。

＜催涙ガス、放火、略奪も＞

大半の抗議行動は正午ごろに始まったが、デモの正式な開始時刻より前に始まったものもあった。

パリの一部地区では、警察が若者を中心とするデモ参加者に押されて後退しながら催涙弾を発射した。参加者の多くは黒い服を着て、催涙ガスに備えてフードやマスク、ゴーグルを着用していた。暴徒たちは中心部の百貨店「ギャラリー・ラファイエット」への侵入を試み、銀行や店舗を荒らし、携帯電話会社の店舗を襲撃した。デモ参加者による放火は終日続き、多数の車などが燃やされた。

ベルギーのブリュッセルでは、フランスの抗議行動に触発されたとみられる若者ら数百人がデモを行い、一部が警察と衝突した。ベルギーの学生団体は、教育費の上昇と、高等教育を受けにくくする恐れがある改革に抗議していると説明している。

アルバニアでは、ラマ首相の辞任を求める学生の大規模デモが５日目に入り、警察が参加者に向けてゴム弾とみられる弾丸を発射した。

住宅費やその他の生活費への抗議行動が数日間続いているポルトガルでは、数万人がリスボンの街頭に繰り出した。ポルトガルの住宅価格は２０１７年以来２倍に跳ね上がり、住宅取得の困難さは欧州でも最も深刻な水準にある。

イタリアでは、ミラノで生活費の高騰に抗議するデモ行進が混乱に陥り、警察は催涙ガスを使用して中心部の大聖堂広場を制圧した。ＡＮＳＡ通信によると、ボローニャでは別の抗議デモが暴徒化し、警察が群衆を解散させるために放水車を使用。７人を拘束した。

＜仏警察の対応に批判＞

フランスの抗議行動は９月、労働者層が多いパリ北部郊外の高校で始まった。教員不足や施設の老朽化に対する怒りが、格差や公共支出、生活水準を巡る幅広い抗議運動に発展した。

パリでは１７日、蛍光ベストを着た抗議者たちが道路を封鎖した。フランスでは、マクロン大統領の一期目も「黄色いベスト運動」と呼ばれる抗議活動が起きたが、今回のデモ参加者数は当時のピーク時の規模を上回った。ただ、２３年の年金制度改革反対デモの規模には及ばなかった。

デモ参加者に負傷者が出たことを受け、警察の対応に批判が集まっている。警察の監察機関は、警察による暴力行為の疑いがある少なくとも２４件について調査を始めた。 

ルコルニュ首相は、１７日の抗議活動で１５０人以上の警察官が負傷したと述べたが、デモ参加者に負傷者がいたかどうかについては言及しなかった。

ヌニェス内相は、１７日の警察との衝突で１人が片手を失ったとの報道を確認した。フランスのメディアによると、この人物は閃光手りゅう弾を拾おうとしたとされる。

警察労組ＵＮＳＡは、複数の場所で群衆がこん棒やれんがを使って警察車両を襲う映像をＸに投稿した。同労組は政府に対し、警察は限界に達しつつあると警告した。

items.title: Kent Johnson tallies in OT as Blue Jackets blank Rangers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kent Johnson scored with 1:34 remaining in overtime as the Columbus Blue Jackets finally solved rookie goalie Dylan Garand and earned a 1-0 victory over the visiting New York Rangers on Saturday night.
items.body:
Kent Johnson scored with 1:34 remaining in overtime as the Columbus Blue Jackets finally solved rookie goalie Dylan Garand and earned a 1-0 victory over the visiting New York Rangers on Saturday night.
After seeing his first three shots stopped by Garand and five other attempts blocked by the Rangers' defense, Johnson scored for the third straight game by teaming up with Charlie Coyle and Zach Werenski for the game-winner.
As Columbus entered the offensive zone, Coyle moved past New York defenseman Sean Durzi near the right corner and spotted Werenski in the slot. Werenski quickly shifted the puck to Johnson, whose one-timer from above the right circle eluded Garand.
Johnson's ninth career game-winner helped the Blue Jackets avoid a third straight loss after coach Rick Bowness described their effort in Tuesday's 7-3 setback to the Florida Panthers as "embarrassing."
Columbus goalie Jet Graves made 29 saves for his fifth career shutout. He was flawless after allowing 11 goals in his first four appearances and made five saves on three New York power plays after permitting four power-play goals on Tuesday.
Johnson scored after the Blue Jackets could not break the ice on a power-play opportunity in the opening minutes of overtime. Garand kept the game scoreless with a windmill glove save on Sean Monahan with one second left in the man advantage.
Late in regulation, Garand made a diving skate save on Cole Sillinger and also denied Adam Fantilli, who recorded a team-high five shots.
He finished with 28 saves. The Rangers' 21-year-old winger Gabe Perreault led all players with six shots.
Garand's big performance was not enough to prevent the Rangers from consecutive losses for the first time this season, though he was significantly better than in Thursday's 7-1 loss in New Jersey when he was pulled after allowing four goals on 13 shots.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Red Wings rally late, beat Sharks in shootout
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Lucas Raymond had the only goal during a shootout as the host Detroit Red Wings topped the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday.
items.body:
Lucas Raymond had the only goal during a shootout as the host Detroit Red Wings topped the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday.
Alex DeBrincat scored with 1:33 left in regulation to send the game into overtime. Emmitt Finnie had a goal and an assist, Justin Faulk also scored and Moritz Seider notched two assists for the Red Wings, who have won two in a row. John Gibson made 31 saves for the victory.
San Jose star Macklin Celebrini racked up a goal and two assists, Dmitry Orlov and Ivar Stenberg supplied power-play goals and Stenberg added an assist. Alex Nedeljkovic stopped 24 shots for the Sharks, who fell to 1-2-1 in their past four games.
With Gibson pulled for an extra skater, DeBrincat scored on a tip-in to tie the game at 3-all. Viktor Arvidsson and Seider had the assists.
Detroit had to kill off an Andrew Copp penalty in overtime to force a shootout.
The Red Wings cashed in on their first power play with 7:13 left in the first period. With Mason Marchment in the penalty box for interference, Faulk fired a shot from just inside the blue line that deflected off a defender's skate and past Nedeljkovic. Finnie and Michael Rasmussen picked up the assists.
San Jose knotted the score with 2:01 left in the period on its second power play. With Ben Chiarot in the penalty box for holding, Orlov scored on a shot from the point. Stenberg and Celebrini collected the assists.
Detroit defenseman William Wallinder turned the puck over in his own zone, allowing the Sharks to take the lead at 4:55 of the second period. Celebrini scored his third goal with a slap shot from the slot. Will Smith and Michael Kesselring had the assists.
Both teams killed off a pair of penalties later in the middle period.
With Red Wings defenseman Andreas Englund in the penalty box for tripping, San Jose made it 3-1 at 2:48 of the third. Stenberg scored in front off a feed from Alexander Wennberg. Celebrini notched the secondary assist.
Finnie scored just over two minutes later, tapping in a Michael Brandsegg-Nygard shot attempt.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Deaths confirmed after 'serious incident,' fire at Canada military base in Alberta
items.author: Amanda Stephenson
items.creator: Amanda Stephenson
items.summary: People were killed and injured in a serious incident that resulted in a fire on one of Canada's busiest military bases in Alberta, Defense Minister David McGuinty said on Saturday.
items.body:
People were killed and injured in a serious incident that resulted in a fire on one of Canada's busiest military bases in Alberta, Defense Minister David McGuinty said on Saturday.
"I'm saddened to share that there have been both fatalities and injuries as a result of an incident" at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, McGuinty told reporters in Ottawa.
He did not say how many people were killed or injured, or what caused the "tragic" situation at the base in the east-central part of the province, about 210 km (130 miles) east of Edmonton.
A major fire was still burning on Saturday evening, he said, adding: "I cannot recall an incident like this in recent memory."
The Canadian military and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police are investigating the incident, McGuinty said.
Prime Minister Mark Carney posted on social media that the national government was "working closely with the Government of Alberta and local authorities."
CFB Wainwright had 1,310 military and civilian personnel stationed there as of 2021, according to census data. The town of Wainwright, population about 6,600, is just north of the base.
The municipality posted on social media that the fire had crossed the base fence into the nearby district but no evacuation orders had been issued.
General Jennie Carignan, the chief of Canada's Defense Staff, said on social media that the Canadian forces are fully engaged with federal, provincial and local authorities.
"Our priority remains the welfare of our members, their families and their community," she said.
(This story has been corrected to add the dropped word 'not' in paragraph 3.)

items.title: Cole Caufield scores in regulation, OT as Canadiens nip Sabres
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Cole Caufield scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime, lifting the Montreal Canadiens to a 4-3 win against the visiting Buffalo Sabres on Saturday.
items.body:
Cole Caufield scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime, lifting the Montreal Canadiens to a 4-3 win against the visiting Buffalo Sabres on Saturday.
Seconds after the Sabres' Josh Norris missed the net on a 3-on-1, the puck rolled down the left side and Caufield collected it to break in and beat Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen bar down.
Zachary Bolduc and Alexandre Texier also scored for the Canadiens, who earned their third win in four games. Montreal's Juraj Slafkovsky and Alexandre Carrier each had two assists, and Jacob Fowler made 23 saves.
Norris, Jack Quinn and Tage Thompson scored for the Sabres, who earned a point for the fourth consecutive game (2-0-2). Luukkonen stopped 30 shots.
Thompson was uncovered at the right of the net to receive a cross-ice pass from Josh Doan and tie it 3-3 at 10:12 of the third period.
Norris gave Buffalo a 1-0 lead at 8:21 of the first period. Konsta Helenius fired a shot from the top of the right circle for a redirect by Norris. Fowler made the save, but Norris stayed with it and snapped the rebound past the goalie from the right side of the net.
Bolduc tied it on a power play on Montreal's first shot on goal, tipping a Nick Suzuki shot on the blocker side past Luukkonen at 11:45 of the first.
Caufield made it 2-1 for the Canadiens less than three minutes later. Buffalo's Olen Zellweger went to retrieve the puck behind his net, but Slafkovsky used his reach to poke it over to Caufield, who quickly put it short side from the left of the net.
Montreal capitalized on a faceoff win to push the lead to 3-1 at 7:39 of the second period. Phillip Danault won the draw, Bolduc collected it and fed it to Carrier, who quickly dished it to Kaiden Guhle at the left point. Luukkonen made the save, but Texier was right there to clean up the rebound and put it by Luukkonen's right pad.
Quinn notched his first career short-handed goal to pull Buffalo within one. Zach Benson retrieved a loose puck near the left corner and zipped it to Quinn driving to the net, where he put the puck past Fowler's right skate at 9:52 of the middle period.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝ドラフト全体1位指名、ウィザーズのディバンツァが負傷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１７日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［１７日　ロイター］　 - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）ウィザーズは、今年のドラフトの全体１位で指名したフォワードのＡＪ・ディバンツァ（１９）が、１６日に行われたプレシーズン最終戦のペリカンズ戦で足首に軽度の捻挫を負ったと発表した。

ディバンツァはこの試合の第２クオーターにジャンプシュートを放った後、ぎこちない形で着地し、転倒。足を引きずりながらロッカールームへと下がった。約１５分プレーし、１２得点を挙げたが、ウィザーズは１０６─１０７で負けた。

ブライアン・キーフ・ヘッドコーチはディバンツァについて、大事を取って交代させたとコメント。同選手はさらに検査を受ける予定という。同選手はブリガムヤング大学で１年プレーし、全米トップの１試合平均２５．５得点をマークした。

ウィザーズは２１日に地元で行われるシーズン開幕戦でバックスと対戦する。

items.title: Flyers notch first win of season, Dan Vladar shines in goal vs. Senators
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone each recorded a goal and an assist as the Philadelphia Flyers notched their first win of the season Saturday with a 3-1 home victory over the Ottawa Senators.
items.body:
Matvei Michkov and Porter Martone each recorded a goal and an assist as the Philadelphia Flyers notched their first win of the season Saturday with a 3-1 home victory over the Ottawa Senators.
Dan Vladar made 25 saves for Philadelphia, which went 0-6-3 in its first nine contests -- the worst start to a season in franchise history. The Flyers had not scored more than two goals in a game until Trevor Zegras' empty-netter sealed the game in the waning seconds.
Ottawa netminder Linus Ullmark, who came into the contest at 6-0-0 on the year, suffered his first loss despite a steady 25-save effort. Drake Batherson tallied the only goal for the Senators.
Neither team scored in the first period, although Ottawa's Dylan Cozens had a mini-breakaway opportunity that ended with the puck in Vladar's glove. The Flyers outshot the Senators 14-8 in the period -- a step forward for a Philadelphia team that has been outshot badly this season.
Batherson opened the scoring at 5:55 of the second period with his fourth goal of the campaign. Claude Giroux carried the puck on a 2-on-1 and waited until the right moment to feed across to Batherson for the one-timer.
About three minutes later, Philadelphia drew even on a nifty setup by Michkov, who found Martone driving to the net for a well-timed redirection.
The score remained 1-1 until Michkov and Martone teamed up for the go-ahead tally late in the middle session. Martone created the opportunity on the power play, as his blast from the left circle led to a rebound that Michkov rammed home for a 2-1 edge.
Ottawa had two good scoring chances early in the third. Nikolas Matinpalo found some space and took a hard shot that knocked off Vladar's mask. Shortly thereafter, Warren Foegele banged a rebound off the post from close range.
With just over five minutes left, Philadelphia's Tyson Foerster was whistled for delay of game. Ottawa had a couple of quality scoring chances on the ensuing power play, but Vladar held firm.
The Senators pulled Ullmark with about 2 1/2 minutes remaining. They threatened a bit down the stretch but could not get the equalizer, leading to Zegras' empty-netter with 14 seconds left.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Stars stay hot with road shutout of Blackhawks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Arttu Hyry scored twice and Jake Oettinger stopped all 19 shots he faced for his third shutout of the season as the Dallas Stars beat the host Chicago Blackhawks 4-0 on Saturday night.
items.body:
Arttu Hyry scored twice and Jake Oettinger stopped all 19 shots he faced for his third shutout of the season as the Dallas Stars beat the host Chicago Blackhawks 4-0 on Saturday night.
Jason Robertson also scored and assisted on Roope Hintz's third-period goal, as the Stars improved to 4-1-1 since losing their first two games of the season.
Hyry, who totaled three goals in 25 games spanning the past two seasons with Dallas, has already matched that total in eight games to open this season after recording his first career multi-goal contest Saturday.
Meanwhile, Oettinger was hardly tested by Chicago, which went 0-for-4 on the power play. Oettinger, who didn't face more than eight shots on goal in any period, has allowed just six goals on 126 shot attempts while 3-2-1 on the young season.
Dallas, which has yielded 12 non-shootout goals this season, has won 15 of the last 20 meetings versus Chicago.
Spencer Knight made 28 saves for the Blackhawks, who lost for the first time in three games with star Connor Bedard back in the lineup from shoulder surgery. Bedard, who recorded three points in his first two games of the season, was held to two shots on goal Saturday.
Dallas appeared to open the scoring with 7:50 remaining in the first period, but Robertson's goal was overturned upon a Chicago video review challenge for offside. However, Robertson was rewarded with the game's first goal at 4:58 into the second period, when he converted a give-and-go with Mikko Rantanen.
The Stars made it 2-0 with 5:50 remaining in the middle frame. After Oettinger made an elbow save on a Chicago redirect, Dallas transitioned into a two-on-one where Sam Steel fed Hyry, who beat Knight on the rush.
Then, amid a line change just 1:27 into the third period, Hyry took a stretch pass from Nils Lundkvist, broke in and sent a backhander past Knight. Dallas added more insurance with 10:20 remaining, when Hintz sent in a successful wrister from the circle through some traffic that appeared to screen Knight.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Islanders get first road win of season as Leafs lose again
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The New York Islanders secured their first road win of the season with a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.
items.body:
The New York Islanders secured their first road win of the season with a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.
Anthony Duclair and Bo Horvat put the Islanders up 2-0 after 40 minutes and Simon Holmstrom secured the win with a pair of goals in the game's final six minutes as New York improved to 1-2-1 away from home.
Horvat added an assist on Holmstrom's first goal and Ilya Sorokin continued his hot start, turning away 28 shots in his fourth win of the season. Sergei Bobrovsky stopped 16 of 19 shots for Toronto, which got a goal from Colton Sissons.
Duclair opened the scoring 8:18 into the game. Jean-Gabriel Pageau pursued Toronto's Kirill Marchenko behind the net, recovered possession along the sideboards and fed Duclair in the slot, who placed his shot under the arm of Bobrovsky for his second of the year.
Bobrovsky slid across the crease to deny Kyle Palmieri with a minute and a half left in the second, but Horvat chipped in the rebound between Bobrovsky and a sprawling Troy Stecher to make it 2-0. Both teams combined for just 12 shots in the middle frame.
Sissons brought Toronto within a goal 3:54 into the third period, tipping in Stecher's low one-timer from the point. Both of Sissons' goals on the season have come against the Islanders.
Little more than 10 minutes later, Horvat fed the puck to Holmstrom, who ripped the puck past Bobrovsky from the slot and halted a late offensive surge from the home team. Holmstrom followed up with an empty netter with just over two minutes remaining.
With John Tavares out week-to-week (lower-body injury), Nick Paul slotted in at center on the Maple Leafs' second line.
Islanders forwards Matias Maccelli and Calum Ritchie both left the game with injuries in the first period. New York's forward corps may be stretched even thinner in the ongoing absence of Mathew Barzal.
Toronto has allowed three goals or more in seven consecutive games and has lost three straight.
--Field Level Media

items.title: サッカー＝チェルシーＧＫマルティネス、脳震とうで病院に搬送
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［リバプール　１７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［リバプール　１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、チェルシーのＧＫエミリアノ・マルティネス（３４）は１７日、エバートン戦で相手選手と衝突して脳震とうを起こし、病院に搬送された。

マルティネスはゴール前でＦＫに対応しようとした際、エバートンのジャラッド・ブランスウェイトと激突。ブランスウェイトは治療を受けた後に立ち上がったが、マルティネスは地面に横たわったまま治療を受けたのち、担架でピッチから運び出された。

チェルシーのシャビアロンソ監督は「脳震とうということ以外は分からない」とした上で、「彼は搬送されたとき意識はあり、今は病院で念のため検査を受けている。重傷ではないことを願っているが、待つしかない」と述べた。

後半３０分からマルティネスに代わり、２１歳のＧＫマイク・ペンダースが出場。プレミアリーグデビューを果たし、チームにとってリーグ戦では１月以来となる完封に貢献した。チェルシーはペドロ・ネトが２ゴールを挙げ、２─０で勝利した。

items.title: Argentinos Juniors gana a Banfield y trepa a cima de tabla anual del fútbol argentino
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Argentinos Juniors venció el sábado 1-0 en su visita a Banfield y quedó en la cima de la tabla anual del fútbol argentino junto con Boca Juniors a falta de tres jornadas para el final.
items.body:
Argentinos Juniors venció el sábado 1-0 en su visita a Banfield y quedó en la cima de la tabla anual del fútbol argentino junto con Boca Juniors a falta de tres jornadas para el final.
Argentinos llegó a 54 puntos en la sumatoria general, misma cantidad de Boca, en busca de uno de los títulos de la temporada del fútbol argentino.
Ambos aprovecharon el empate de Independiente Rivadavia, que quedó escolta con 53 unidades.
En el partido disputado en el estadio Florencio Sola de Banfield, el gol del triunfo lo anotó el ingresado Matías Giménez Rojas a los 66 minutos tras una gran jugada individual.
"Una felicidad enorme porque todo el año venimos peleándola y este es el resultado. Nos quedan tres finales. Hay que salir campeón, porque hace dos o tres años Argentinos viene llegando lejos hasta el final y no puede coronar, ojalá podamos ahora", dijo Giménez Rojas a la televisión local.
Por su parte, en el estadio Bautista Gargantini de la provincia de Mendoza, Tigre sacó un empate agónico 2-2 en su visita a Independiente Rivadavia y bajó a su rival del liderato de la tabla anual.
Los goles del conjunto mendocino los anotaron Matías Fernández y el paraguayo José Florentín, mientras que para Tigre convirtieron Alan Barrionuevo y Manuel Fernández.
"Tanto en este partido como en el anterior con Gimnasia La Plata se nos escapan cuatro puntos en los últimos minutos del partido. Queda un sabor amargo", dijo en conferencia de prensa el director técnico Alfredo Berti.
En otros partidos disputados el sábado, Vélez Sarsfield ganó 1-0 a Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza, mismo marcador con el que Lanús venció a Platense, mientras que Rosario Central superó 3-2 a Atlético Tucumán.
El viernes, Boca Juniors ganó 2-1 a Talleres de Córdoba, mientras que Instituto de Córdoba superó 1-0 a Defensa y Justicia.
La jornada comenzó el jueves con el triunfo 2-1 de Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata sobre Huracán.

items.title: サッカー＝イプスウィッチ前田、マンＣ戦でプレミア初ゴール
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　１７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ロンドン　１７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１７日、各地で試合を行い、イプスウィッチの前田大然がマンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）戦で同リーグでの初ゴールを挙げた。

先発した前田は先制された２分後の前半２１分、右サイドで味方からのパスに追い付き、左足でシュート。開幕から７試合目で待望の初得点をマークした。この後アーリング・ハーランドに２ゴールを決められたイプスウィッチは、後半４５分にＰＫで１点を返したが、２─３で敗戦。前田は後半２６分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶が所属するアストンビラはニューカッスルに１─０で勝利。鈴木はフル出場を果たし、今季初の完封勝利に貢献した。リバプールはブレントフォードに２─１で逆転勝ち。リバプールの遠藤航はベンチ入りしたが、出場しなかった。

守田英正が所属するハルはフラムに０─１で敗戦。守田は後半３０分から出場した。チェルシーはエバートンに２─０で快勝した。

開幕７連勝のマンＣが勝ち点２１で首位。チェルシーが同１３の４位、リバプールが同１２の暫定５位に浮上した。ハルは９位でイプスウィッチは１０位。今季２勝目を挙げたアストンビラは暫定１２位に上がった。

items.title: サッカー＝バイエルン6ゴール圧勝で暫定首位浮上、伊藤は出番なし
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　１７日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　１７日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１７日、各地で試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンがライプチヒを６─１で下し、暫定首位に浮上した。

ホームのバイエルンは前半１２分にルイス・ディアスのゴールで先制すると、前半のうちに３─０とリードを広げ、後半にも立ち上がりの２分にディアスが加点。同８分には、これがブンデスリーガ通算１００試合目の出場となったハリー・ケーンがゴールを挙げ、最後はディアスがハットトリックを達成した。失点は同アディショナルタイムに喫した１点のみだった。

伊藤はこの試合でベンチ入りしたが、最後まで出番はなかった。

佐野海舟がフル出場したマインツは、田中聡フル出場のシャルケに１─０で勝利。マインツの川崎颯太はベンチ入りしなかった。

ドルトムントがウニオン・ベルリンと０─０のドローに終わったため、６試合消化段階でバイエルンが勝ち点１４でドルトムントと並び、得失点差により暫定首位に浮上した。

items.title: ボクシング＝亀田和毅のタイトルマッチ、相手の体調不良で当日中止に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１７日　ロイター］ - プロボクシングの亀田和毅（３５）は１７日、米ラスベガスで世界ボクシング協会（ＷＢＡ）世界フェザー級タイトルマッチを行う予定だったが、対戦相手の体調不良により、試合当日に中止となった。米ボクシング専門サイト、ボクシングシーンなどが報じている。

ブランドン・フィゲロア（２９、米国）は１６日の前日計量で規定体重（５７．１５キロ）を２回クリアできず、体重超過でタイトルを剥奪されていた。１回目の計量では約０．６キロのオーバー。１時間後に行われた２回目の計量でも体重は減っていなかった。

亀田はこの試合に勝てば新王者となり、引き分けか負けた場合、王座は空位となる予定だった。亀田の戦績は４２勝５敗。フィゲロアは２６勝２敗１分け。

items.title: Florida State RB Ousmane Kromah carted off with ankle injury
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah was carted off with an apparent left ankle injury during the second quarter of Saturday's game at No. 3 Miami.
items.body:
Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah was carted off with an apparent left ankle injury during the second quarter of Saturday's game at No. 3 Miami.
Kromah was headed for the corner of the end zone when he was tackled from behind by Miami linebacker Chase Smith. As he went to the ground, Smith's ankle caught below Him and twisted awkwardly.
Kromah got up and tried to hop off the field before going to the ground as the Seminoles' medical staff rushed to treat him. His left leg was placed in an air cast before he was carted to the locker room.
Kromah entered Saturday as Florida State's leading rusher with 565 yards and five touchdowns on 100 carries. Kromah had 44 yards on 14 carries on Saturday night before the injury.
--Field Level Media
