items.title: Hurricane Trudy gains strength near Mexico's coast, but is expected to weaken by Sunday
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Hurricane Trudy gained some strength as it moved toward Mexico's western coast on Saturday, with forecasters warning it could strengthen a little more overnight before beginning to weaken on Sunday.
items.body:
Hurricane Trudy gained some strength as it moved toward Mexico's western coast on Saturday, with forecasters warning it could strengthen a little more overnight before beginning to weaken on Sunday.
The US National Hurricane Center said Trudy was about 115 miles (180 km) south-southwest of Manzanillo on Saturday afternoon, with maximum sustained winds of 100 mph (155 kph).
The hurricane was moving at about 10 mph (17 kph) and was forecast to approach the southwestern and west-central Mexican coast and pass near the coast overnight into Sunday.
Hurricane conditions are expected in the warning area on Saturday night, while tropical storm conditions are expected to spread across the region on Saturday afternoon and evening, the NHC said. Hurricane conditions are also possible in areas under a hurricane watch.
Trudy is forecast to bring 4 to 8 inches (10 to 20 cm) of rain, with higher totals of around 12 inches, across parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco through the weekend, raising the risk of life-threatening flooding and landslides, especially in steep terrain, according to the NHC.
Outer rain bands could produce 2 to 4 inches of rain, with isolated totals of around 6 inches, in Guerrero and Nayarit, where localized flash flooding is possible, the center said.
The NHC also warned of dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas exposed to onshore winds.
Swells generated by Trudy were already affecting parts of Mexico's southwestern coast and are expected to spread northward toward the country's west-central coast through the weekend, creating life-threatening surf and rip current conditions, the NHC said.
Mexico's national water agency, CONAGUA, has officially classified Trudy as a Category 2 hurricane.

items.summary: Liverpool came from a goal down to beat Brentford 2-1 away.
items.body:
Manchester City bounced back from their midweek setback in Europe to maintain their perfect Premier League start with Erling Haaland's double propelling them to a 3-2 home win over battling Ipswich Town on Saturday.
Paris St Germain inflicted a first meaningful defeat on Enzo Maresca's side in the Champions League on Wednesday but City shrugged off a gallant Ipswich side to make it seven wins from seven to cement their place at the top of the table.
Chelsea beat Everton 2-0 in Saturday's early action thanks to Pedro Neto's brace although the London club's win was overshadowed by an injury to [USN:L4N46302T TEXT:"goalkeeper Emi Martinez"].
Liverpool came from a goal down to beat Brentford 2-1 away although they were helped by the previously unbeaten hosts being reduced to 10 men shortly before halftime when Yehor Yarmolyuk was shown a straight red card for a head butt.
Manchester City have 21 points, six ahead of second-placed champions Arsenal, who visit Nottingham Forest on Sunday. Liverpool's win lifted them above Brentford into fifth place with 12 points behind Chelsea in fourth on 13.
Third-placed Brighton & Hove Albion, who also have 13 points, host Crystal Palace on Sunday.
Fulham moved off the foot of the table with their first league win of the season -- 1-0 at home to Hull City -- while Aston Villa won by the same scoreline at Newcastle United.
BUSINESS AS USUAL FOR CITY Dark clouds remain over the Etihad Stadium with Manchester City's fate still unknown after they appealed a ruling that the club breached 114 Premier League financial rules.
City have always denied any wrongdoing.
But on the pitch it is very much business as usual, especially for Norwegian goal machine Haaland.
Phil Foden gave City a short-lived lead cancelled out by Daizen Maeda, but Haaland restored the home side's advantage before halftime with a header from Mateo Kovacic's cross.
Haaland then gave his side some breathing space with his second in the 69th minute, powering past Ipswich's Abdoul Ouattara before a low finish into the corner.
He was denied a hat-trick by an offside decision and Ipswich got a lifeline when Zian Flemming tucked away a penalty in stoppage time but City bagged the points.
The defiant mood was soured somewhat though as [USN:L8N46309A TEXT:"Haaland went off"] with an apparent injury late on, as did Mateo Kovacic, Matheus Nunes and Nico O'Reilly, while Antoine Semenyo was also limping badly at the final whistle.
"I don't know (Haaland's injury)," Maresca said. "I asked him. He said that he was okay. So hopefully, it's nothing serious."
FEISTY FIRST HALF Chelsea have had a knack of scoring early this season but were kept at bay by hosts Everton in a feisty and physical first half that produced five yellow cards.
However, Xabi Alonso's visitors needed just 43 seconds after the restart to go 1-0 up when Jorrel Hato cut the ball back from the byline to find Neto who swept home.
Keeper Martinez's clash of heads with Jarrad Branthwaite resulted in the Argentine being strapped to a stretcher and taken off, leading to 11 minutes of stoppage time.
Chelsea doubled their lead in the 90th minute when Neto pounced on a loose ball after Jordan Henderson's free kick was blocked by the wall, finding the bottom corner with a composed finish as Everton suffered their first defeat of the season.
"What we know is he (Martinez) left the stadium conscious and right now he is in the hospital doing precautionary tests," Alonso said. "It was concussion but more than that I saw only one clip. Hopefully it won't be too bad but we need to wait."
Martinez's knock gave 21-year-old keeper Mike Penders the chance to make his Premier League debut and he helped Chelsea keep a clean sheet in the league for the first time in 23 games.
"We need a clean sheet, to be honest. I think we did a very good game. Emi deserved this, Mike did as well," Alonso added.
BRENTFORD'S YARMOLYUK SENT OFF Liverpool deservedly fell behind at Brentford with Keane Lewis-Potter putting the hosts in front.
Brentford were good value for their lead but Yarmolyuk's rush of blood to the head when he clashed with Jeremy Jacquet at a Liverpool corner changed the game.
After referee John Brooks was invited to check a VAR monitor he brandished the red card at Ukrainian Yarmolyuk.
Liverpool huffed and puffed after the break but Victor Munoz finally levelled in the 62nd minute when he cut in to beat keeper Caoimhin Kelleher with a left-foot finish.
Alexander Isak won it for Andoni Iraola's side eight minutes later with a clinical strike from Bradley Barcola's assist.
Brentford ended with nine men after Vitaly Janelt got a second yellow card for a foul on substitute Rio Ngumoha.
Alex Iwobi's 33rd-minute strike for Fulham was enough to earn their new manager Alvaro Arbeloa a long-overdue league win and move Fulham up to 16th. Johan Manzambi's early goal secured Villa's victory at Newcastle, their second of the season.

items.title: Trump faults aides as Republican midterm prospects dim
items.author: Nandita Bose, Bo Erickson, Steve Holland
items.creator: Nandita Bose, Bo Erickson, Steve Holland
items.summary: "What's really happening is a circular firing squad."
items.body:
President Donald Trump is blaming senior aides and political operatives for a faltering [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm strategy"], questioning campaign spending, faulting redistricting and second-guessing candidate choices as Republicans fight to retain control of Congress, said three people familiar with internal discussions.
Trump is not on the November 3 ballot but repeatedly tells supporters to pretend that he is, hoping to mobilize voters who might otherwise skip the election. He has embarked on a frenetic campaign schedule while largely avoiding acknowledging his own role in shaping the strategy and how his unpopularity is weighing on Republican candidates in competitive races.
Much of the friction has centered on James Blair, the longtime aide who runs Trump's super PAC MAGA Inc., and White House chief of staff Susie Wiles, who until now had largely escaped criticism. Trump has faulted Blair's handling of campaign funds, while some White House officials and allies have questioned Wiles' oversight of the political operation.
As Trump questions why campaign spending has failed to improve Republican polling numbers, his advisers are also blaming one another. Wiles has pointed to Blair, while Blair has faulted the White House legislative affairs team, one of the people said.
"What's really happening is a circular firing squad," the person said.
Opinion polls suggest Democrats will win the House of Representatives, while the Senate remains too close to call. Losing the House would hamper Trump's legislative agenda in the final two years of his term and give Democrats subpoena power to investigate his administration.
Trump defended Wiles on Friday, calling her "smart" and "tough" and saying she would remain in her job. "Susie is here, and she's going to be here for a long time," he said.
White House spokesman Davis Ingle rejected the sources' characterization, saying they were "armchair experts peddling their baseless speculation." Wiles did not respond to a request for comment.
TRUMP HAS LONG DISTANCED HIMSELF FROM POLITICAL SETBACKS Trump has long sought to distance himself from political setbacks. He refused to accept his defeat in the 2020 election and said ahead of the 2022 midterm results that he deserved "all the credit" if Republicans won but "should not be blamed at all" if they lost. More recently, he has reminded audiences that the president's party typically struggles in midterm elections.
But Trump helped devise and drive some of the strategies he is now questioning, including the redistricting effort and candidate choices shaped by his personal loyalties or grievances. His approval rating is at the lowest point of his presidency, weighed down by voter concern over high prices and dissatisfaction with the Iran war.
Trump's frustrations with his political team spilled into public view after Blair and Chris LaCivita, who co-managed Trump's 2024 campaign, traveled in early October to Republika Srpska, a self-governing region of Bosnia. The New York Times reported the men received substantial payments to advise the regional government ahead of local elections.
Trump distanced himself from both men, describing them as "outside consultants" in an October 7 Truth Social post and warning that if he found a conflict of interest, he would "terminate them, immediately!"
Senior White House officials questioned why Blair was taking on lucrative work overseas when he was supposed to be overseeing the final stretch of the Republican campaign, three people said.
One person said Wiles approved the trip without informing Trump, raising questions about how closely she was overseeing his political advisers.
For Trump, the larger concern is that Blair's outside work has distracted him from his political responsibilities, two people said.
In a statement, Blair said: "All of this mudslinging is ridiculous, and counterproductive. President Trump and me are focused on helping Republicans win in November. Every other Republican should be doing the same."
In a separate statement, LaCivita said: "President Trump and his team are and always have been focused on the midterms. That's demonstrated through the money, message and motivation that the president is bringing on the road and all year. Sniping from unnamed cowards who've never been in a fight is not worth responding to."
$200 MILLION AND REDISTRICTING With Trump asking why Republican polling in pivotal races has not improved despite MAGA Inc.'s campaign spending, which public records put at $200 million so far, it remains unclear whether he will approve more spending before the election, one of the sources said.
Trump also has pressed political aides and advisers in the past week to explain why the redistricting effort he personally pushed has failed to deliver more clear-cut Republican gains, two sources said.
Texas is a particular concern. Republicans redrew the state's congressional map to gain seats, but the strategy relies in part on Hispanic voters turning out as they did for the 2024 election. Opinion polls suggest that support may be difficult to replicate amid concerns about the cost of living and Trump's handling of the economy. Some Republicans fear the new boundaries could backfire, leaving incumbents more vulnerable instead of giving the party an advantage.
"The redistricting diced up the Trump voters too much," one of the sources said.
Trump had said Blair was expected to return to the White House after the midterms, describing his departure as a "short leave of absence." But two sources said his return was now unlikely. "He's not coming back. That is not happening," one of them said.
It was less clear how things would play out for Wiles, who played a central role in Trump's 2024 victory and has been credited by Trump allies and aides with bringing greater discipline to his White House in his second term.
Trump "may be annoyed at certain things but she has effectively kept that machine going," a fourth source close to the White House said.

items.title: Trump-Zelenskiy rift threatens vital support for Kyiv
items.author: Simon Lewis, Steve Holland, Daniel Flynn
items.creator: Simon Lewis, Steve Holland, Daniel Flynn
items.summary: Zelenskiy responded to Trump's barbs with an unusually sharp series of public criticisms of Trump, suggesting the US was now favoring Russia.
items.body:
From US threats to cut off intelligence support for Ukraine to a waiver of tariffs on Russian exports and a [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"diesel deal"] that could help Russia fund its war, it has been a damaging week for ties between Kyiv and its most important ally, Washington.
US President Donald Trump, frustrated by high energy costs he blames partly on Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, has repeatedly criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. A disruption of US-provided satellite internet services raised fears that Ukraine could be vulnerable as it prepares for another [USN:L6N4620NO TEXT:"winter of Russian attacks"] on its energy infrastructure.
Zelenskiy responded to Trump's barbs with an [USN:L8N4620FR TEXT:"unusually sharp"] series of public criticisms of Trump, suggesting the US was now favoring Russia. He said Ukraine would defy Trump's demand to stop striking Russian energy targets, citing Russia's continued attacks.
Intensifying the discord, Trump [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"waived key US Russia-related sanctions and tariffs"] on Friday, shortly before they were scheduled to take effect. That prompted Zelenskiy to say in social media posts that Trump's action would encourage Russia to continue attacks on Ukraine.
The widening rift has sparked concerns that Trump and Zelenskiy's tumultuous relationship could lead to even worse outcomes for Kyiv. Trump could yet restrict the supply of weapons to Ukraine, follow through on threats to stop sharing battlefield intelligence, or strike more economic deals with Moscow.
Despite Zelenskiy's remarks, Kyiv wants to continue dialogue with Trump's envoys, his friend Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner, two Ukrainian officials familiar with the talks said, speaking on the condition of anonymity.
Denys Sienik, chargé d'affaires at Ukraine's embassy in Washington, told Newsmax on Friday that Ukraine was grateful to Trump and his team for their efforts to end the war and said Ukraine was willing to engage in talks with Russia.
Trump told reporters on Friday he would continue to deal with both Zelenskiy and Russian President Vladimir Putin. “I want that war to end,” he said.
'MISSED OPPORTUNITY': FORMER US OFFICIAL Daniel Fried, the senior State Department official on Europe from 2005 to 2009, said it was unclear whether Washington was making a lasting shift away from Ukraine, but the fallout was damaging prospects for an end to the war that began with Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion.
"It's not only a missed opportunity, it causes genuine suffering in Ukraine and encourages Putin to continue the war, so it's not cost-free," said Fried, now at the Washington-based Atlantic Council think tank.
Trump's relationship with Zelenskiy has long been uneasy. Trump and US Vice President JD Vance publicly upbraided Zelenskiy during an Oval Office meeting in February 2025. Washington has paused or slowed military assistance to Ukraine under Trump, while allowing European allies to purchase US weapons for Kyiv.
The relationship had steadied until Ukraine's strikes this year on energy sites in Russia began contributing to rising fuel prices. High gasoline and diesel prices are a political headache for Trump ahead of November's midterm elections, in which his Republican Party could lose its majorities in the US Congress, according to analysts.
Experts say that surge in energy costs is mainly the result of the US-Israeli war with Iran , which brought Iranian attacks on energy facilities and has largely shut the vital Strait of Hormuz.
Frustrated by Zelenskiy, however, Trump turned to Russia to increase fuel supply and contain prices, according to a person familiar with the internal debate, who spoke on the condition of anonymity.
Trump said on October 9 he had reached a deal with Putin to temporarily lift sanctions on Russian fuel and import Russian diesel.
In an executive order released by the White House on Friday, Trump also waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs shortly before they were supposed to take effect under the Graham Act, which Trump signed last month.
Although the law, named for the late US Senator Lindsey Graham, called for new penalties on Russia starting next week, it also allows the president to waive them if it is in the US national interest to do so.
Zelenskiy said Trump's latest action undercuts the Graham Act's main goal and will fuel Russia's "desire to keep killing people."
The US diesel deal with Russia and the waiver are the latest steps in what Zelenskiy said he expects to be continued sanctions relief on Moscow.
The prospect of the US continuing to pressure Russia to end the war has dimmed since Graham's death in July, Zelenskiy said. Graham, a South Carolina Republican and a confidant of Trump, strongly supported Ukraine.
"It’s difficult without him, I’ll be honest," the Ukrainian president wrote.
HIGH STAKES FOR UKRAINE For Kyiv, the stakes are high and immediate. Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that Ukraine had received no warning from Western partners before a deadly [USN:L4N45Z20E TEXT:"Russian attack"] on the capital.
Without US intelligence, Ukraine could face greater difficulty detecting and countering Russian missile and drone attacks, particularly against energy infrastructure that Moscow has repeatedly targeted during previous winters.
Trump has said the US is still sharing intelligence with Ukraine. But Zelenskiy told NPR that US officials had warned Ukrainian commanders intelligence could be reduced or cut off.
Ukraine's Starshield system, the military-grade version of SpaceX's Starlink service, was [USN:L8N46213X TEXT:"disrupted"] after what two US officials and a Western official briefed on the matter said was [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"an order originating from the White House"], Reuters reported on Thursday.
The service has been partially restored, but the episode highlighted the vulnerability created by Ukraine's dependence on technology controlled by US companies and subject to decisions by the Trump administration.
Trump may face resistance if congressional Republicans see his approach as weakening Ukraine while benefiting Russia. Ukraine retains support among Trump's fellow Republicans, some of whom [USN:L1N45Z0TJ TEXT:"argue that"] Washington should not pressure Kyiv into accepting a settlement on terms favorable to Moscow.
Zelenskiy's tough responses to Trump were risky, but he may be counting on a power shift on Capitol Hill after the midterm elections to make it harder for Trump to ease sanctions on Russia and further reduce military assistance to Kyiv, said Brett Bruen, a former foreign policy adviser in the Obama administration and head of the Global Situation Room consultancy.
“Zelenskiy knows who he’s dealing with,” he said. “Trump’s threats don’t have the same kind of effect as they did when JD Vance tried to shame him in the Oval Office.”

AI rapidly improving, could vastly boost US GDP, Anthropic's Clark tells policymakers

Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark attends "AI and the Global Economy: From Risk to Opportunity" at the IMF/World Bank 2026 Annual Meetings at Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC) in Bangkok, Thailand, October 16, 2026. REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

BANGKOK, Oct 17 : Rapidly improving artificial intelligence capabilities will bring far faster change across all fields, Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark said on Saturday, with one of the company's internal models forecasting that under certain conditions it could increase US economic output by almost 50 per cent by 2030.
Clark, speaking at IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, said that international cooperation was needed to erect "unusual and serious rules" for the transformative technology, and there was a shrinking window for policymakers to act.
Clark said that the estimated potential US GDP of $44 trillion, which compares to the current level of just over $30 trillion, "sounds very outlandish, I know." But he added that AI was vastly increasing scientific discovery.
He said the forecast assumed "the technology continuing to get better. And if GDP were to grow this much, then economic doctrine suggests that new industries and inventions would need to have been created to power such a major economic expansion".

Clark's remarks come as the company prepares for an initial public offering expected in November that could value the firm at up to $2 trillion. 
HUMANS IN CONTROL, FOR NOW
Clark issued a wake-up call to policymakers about the speed of AI development, saying there was growing evidence of a "singularity" where AI development outpaces human control.
"We should expect that in the coming years, the whole pace of progress of not just AI but science as a whole will speed up, and this will feel confusing and disorienting, and will bring with it great wealth and potentially great peril," he said in a lecture to hundreds of government and finance officials.
AI was a major topic at the IMF and World Bank meetings, as both a source of growth offsetting high energy prices and a potential threat to stability if it falls short of its promise as a productivity game-changer and stock valuations crash. 
Officials also expressed worries about AI destroying certain jobs and leaving some countries behind.
But Clark, a former journalist who serves as Anthropic's "head of public benefit," painted a picture of a rosy future where AI was a force multiplier for scientific discovery, solving mathematical, engineering and biological problems, including new drug discovery, as human researchers are supplemented by hundreds or thousands of AI assistants. 
More countries can participate in the AI revolution by helping to build the data center computing capacity needed to power AI, he said.
STRICTEST CONTROLS ON BIOLOGICAL RESEARCH
Clark cautioned that global leaders need to understand how powerful AI will become and make urgent choices about how to regulate the technology.
"Being able to use AI for science opens us up to the misuses of science as well, biological and cyber weapons and things we cannot yet imagine, and we have many choices to make," he said.
Biological research, where AI has already created new viruses, is an area "where we want the strictest human oversight and transparency to maintain safety."
Despite some recent high-profile incidents where rogue AI systems have escaped testing environments and hacked websites and databases, he said AI was still under human control. But the window to impose safeguards was shrinking as AI became more capable and was now "a small number of years."
 Clark also acknowledged that AI was causing job losses in some fields with "high AI exposure" such as call centers and customer service personnel. But for other fields, such as scientific research, he said AI was enhancing employment and a major unknown was its potential to create jobs in completely new industries. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: インド警察、「ゴキブリ人民党」創設者を逮捕＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１７日 ロイター] - インドの複数のメディアは１７日、若者中心の団体「ゴキブリ人民党（ＣＪＰ）」の創設者アビジート・ディプケ氏が警察に逮捕されたと報じた。

テレビ局ＮＤＴＶとインディア・トゥデーによると、ディプケ氏は治安の混乱を防ぐために逮捕され、１７日に特別行政治安判事の前に出頭する予定だ。

同氏は拘束されたＣＪＰ幹部２人を支援するため、１６日にデリーで抗議集会を開くよう呼びかけていた。集会には数百人が参加し、国旗を振って選挙管理委員長の辞任を求めた。

ディプケ氏は１６日、デリー中心部の住宅から出たところを拘束され、短い口論の後、パトカーに押し込まれて連れ去られた。警察はこれに先立ち、ディプケ氏と面会し、抗議活動を実施しないよう警告していた。

items.title: ソフトバンクＧ、米警備大手アライド買収検討＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Milana Vinn

[１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Milana Vinn

[１６日 ロイター] - ソフトバンクグループが米警備サービス大手アライド・ユニバーサルの買収を検討している。関係者が１６日明らかにした。買収案では、アライドの評価額が約１８０億ドルになる可能性がある。

アライドは企業や各種施設、大規模イベントに警備員を派遣する事業を手がける。データセンター分野でも事業を拡大しており、施設の開発と運営の両面を支援している。

ソフトバンクはアライドの買収が実現すれば、特定の警備業務で人員の一部をいずれロボットに置き換えることを目指す。ただ人型ロボットの警備業務への導入には長い時間がかかるとみられる。

買収検討は初期段階にあり、買収額を含め、最終決定には至っていないという。

items.title: トランプ氏、対ロシア制裁法の適用を発動直前に免除
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kanishka Singh　Jasper Ward

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kanishka Singh　Jasper Ward

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は先月署名した法律に基づくロシア関連の主要な制裁と関税の適用を免除した。ロシア製品への関税や、同国の石油・天然ガスを購入する国への制裁が対象となる。これらは数日後に発効する予定だった。

ホワイトハウスが１６日に公表した大統領令で、トランプ氏は適用免除が米国の国益にかなうと説明した。免除はトランプ氏または政府高官が「追加措置が適切」と判断するまで有効となる。

同法は共和党の故リンゼー・グラム上院議員が推進し、トランプ氏が９月中旬に署名した。ロシア産原油・天然ガスの輸入上位５カ国から米国に輸入される製品に、３０日以内に最大１００％の関税を課す内容となっていた。法律成立から３０日後以降にロシア産と知りながら石油・天然ガスを購入した国や、ロシアの制裁逃れを支援する上位５カ国も対象に含まれていた。

トランプ氏は大統領令で「現時点でこうした適用免除を行うことが米国の国益にかなうとする証明書を議会に提出した」と述べた。同法では、大統領は制裁が国益にかなわないと判断したと議会に通知するだけで、制裁を免除できる。

バージニア州選出のドン・ベイヤー民主党下院議員は、今回の措置を強く批判した。声明で「トランプ氏は今回もプーチン（ロシア大統領）に屈し、パートナーであるウクライナを再び裏切った。ロシアの違法な侵略戦争を罰するための法律に込められた議会の明確な意思にも背いている」と述べた。

トランプ氏は最近ロシアと結んだ軽油に関する合意でも、一部の共和党議員を含む複数の米上院議員から批判を受けていた。

items.title: Mass protests in France spiral into worst riots in years
items.author: Janis Laizans, Stamos Prousalis, Yann Tessier
items.creator: Janis Laizans, Stamos Prousalis, Yann Tessier
items.summary: Authorities reported violent incidents in several cities, including vandalism in Marseille and attacks targeting police, media and public buildings.
items.body:
Rioting erupted in cities across France on Saturday as demonstrations against rising living costs and declining public services spiralled out of control in some of the worst violence the country has witnessed for decades.
While hundreds of thousands protested peacefully in street marches in scores of cities, violent fringe groups targeted public buildings, looted luxury boutiques and supermarkets and attacked police vehicles and officers.
In Limoges, the city hall was set ablaze; in Marseille, black-clad protesters broke into city hall and defaced the building with anarchic graffiti, and in Lyon, protesters torched the city's tourist office.
French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said the government would not be "intimidated" by violence, and blamed the unrest on the "ultra-left" and criminals just months before a presidential election next year.
"To those who clearly want to use this violence as a 'warm-up' before the presidential election, I say clearly: We will not let ourselves be intimidated. No one will impose their political agenda through violence," he wrote in a post on X.
Some 1,200 people had been arrested as part of the protests, Lecornu added while visiting the sites in the evening.
Around 550,000 people had participated in the demonstrations across the country, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said. The CGT union told Reuters it estimated protesters at 800,000 people.
President Emmanuel Macron vowed to prosecute and punish people who had carried out the attacks.
"We will all stand united against the sowers of chaos, who only seek to undermine our institutions and prevent those who peacefully express their demands from doing so," he wrote in a post on X.
[USN:L6N46303L TEXT:"Belgium"], [USN:L8N46304H TEXT:"Portugal"] and [USN:L8N463090 TEXT:"Italy"] also faced smaller-scale protests on Saturday as living costs rise in Europe, while protesters in [USN:L6N46303U TEXT:"Albania"] again rallied against perceived government corruption, a lack of jobs and poor education standards.
Protesters said most people had marched peacefully, and put much of the violence down to troublemakers who had set out to cause damage and clash with the police. Many held signs bearing slogans against the police, the president and the wealthy.
"We are fighting because the cost of living is too harsh, because the price of fuel is too high, because high school pupils are being violently attacked and hurt all over the country just for trying to protest and ask for more teachers and decent learning conditions," said Lola, a 19-year-old protester in Paris.
TEAR GAS, FIRE AND LOOTING Most protests kicked off around midday, with some beginning before the official start of the demonstrations.
In some parts of Paris, police fired tear gas rounds as they retreated in the face of mostly young protesters, many of whom were dressed in black and wore hoodies, masks and goggles to protect against tear gas.
Rioters tried to break into the Galeries Lafayette department store, smashed up banks, ransacked a Lacoste store as well as other boutiques and looted an SFR mobile phone shop. Protesters had been setting objects ablaze all day, including numerous cars.
In protests partly inspired by those in France, several hundred mostly young people protested in [USN:L6N46303L TEXT:"Brussels"], and some clashed with police. Belgian student groups have said they are protesting against rising education costs and reforms they fear will make higher education less accessible.
In [USN:L6N46303U TEXT:"Albania"], police fired what appeared to be rubber bullets at protesters during a fifth day of mass student demonstrations calling for Prime Minister Edi Rama to step down.
In [USN:L8N46304H TEXT:"Portugal"], tens of thousands took to the streets of Lisbon following days of unrest to protest against housing and other living costs. Housing prices in Portugal have doubled since 2017, fuelling one of the worst affordability crises in Europe.
In Italy, a march against high costs of living in [USN:L8N463090 TEXT:"Milan"] degenerated into disorder, with police clearing the central cathedral square with tear gas. Police in Bologna used water cannons to try to disperse crowds and made seven arrests after another protest turned violent, the ANSA news agency reported.
FRENCH POLICE RESPONSE UNDER SCRUTINY The protests in France began last month at high schools in Paris' working-class northern suburbs, where anger over teacher shortages and shabby facilities evolved into a broader movement focused on inequality, public spending and living standards.
In Paris on Saturday, protesters in high-visibility vests blocked streets, recalling the Yellow Vest movement that marked Macron's previous term in office.
Saturday's protests eclipsed the size of the crowds at the peak of the Yellow Vest movement, though they were far lower than the levels seen at the protests in 2023 against Macron's pension overhaul.
Macron is entering [USN:L1N45Y033 TEXT:"the final stretch"] of his presidency, facing a fragmented political landscape and growing pressure over the economy.
France's efforts to reduce public debt have not reassured investors, pushing government [USN:L8N45R0RA TEXT:"borrowing costs"] to their highest levels in over two decades.
Police tactics have drawn criticism following [USN:L6N45V0HM TEXT:"injuries"] among demonstrators, including a teenager who lost a hand after picking up a stun grenade. The police watchdog is investigating at least two dozen allegations of police violence.
Lecornu said more than 150 police officers had been injured in Saturday's protests, but did not say whether any protesters had been hurt.
Nunez confirmed reports that one person had his hand torn off in clashes with police on Saturday. French media reported he tried to pick up a stun grenade.
The UNSA police union posted a video on X showing crowds attacking police vans with clubs and bricks in multiple locations. The union warned the government police forces were at breaking point.
"Today again, in every corner of France, our colleagues are being used as punching bags. Pelted with stones, injured, trapped in real ambushes," the union said. "Let everyone take responsibility: this cannot go on indefinitely. The rope is stretched to its maximum."

MANILA, Oct 17 : Multilateral development banks (MDBs) will strengthen efforts to help mineral-rich developing economies add more value to their resources by moving beyond extraction into processing, refining and manufacturing, according to an outline of a critical minerals collaboration framework published on Saturday.
• The banks involved include the World Bank, the African Development Bank, the Asian Development Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the European Investment Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank, according to the outline
• The October framework calls for coordinated support across critical mineral supply chains, including financing, infrastructure and policy aimed at creating jobs, boosting domestic value addition, attracting private investment and supporting low-carbon transition
• MDBs plan to support mineral corridors incorporating power, transport, logistics, water and digital infrastructure, while strengthening project preparation and using co-financing, guarantees and other financing tools to mobilise capital and accelerate private sector investments

items.title: サッカー＝インテル、主将マルティネスが負傷で7試合欠場へ─報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイタリア・セリエＡ、インテルの主将ラウタロ・マルティネスがハムストリングの負傷により今後７試合を欠場する見通しとなった。米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが１６日に伝えた。

マルティネスは１３日にホームで行われた欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）、３─４で敗れたクラブ・ブルージュ（ベルギー）戦にフル出場し、２得点を記録。しかし、１５日に行った検査の結果、左ハムストリングの肉離れが判明した。

インテルのクリスティアン・キブ監督は１６日、「彼はしばらく離脱することになる。私は医師ではないが、復帰までの目安は聞いている。おそらく代表戦期間明けには戻ってくるだろう」と述べた。

これにより、マルティネスは１７日のボローニャ戦と、２１日のＣＬシャフタル・ドネツク（ウクライナ）戦の欠場が確実となった。１１月の代表戦期間までには、３１日に行われるＡＣミランとのダービーを含め、７試合が予定されている。

マルティネスは今季、公式戦７試合に出場して６得点を記録。昨季はセリエＡで１７ゴールを挙げ、自身２回目となるリーグ得点王に輝いている。

items.summary: [１７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１７日 ロイター] - イエメンのアデン国際空港に１６日、ミサイルが着弾した。一方、サウジアラビア主導の連合軍は、紅海沿岸の都市ヤンブーに向かっていた弾道ミサイルを迎撃したと発表した。

連合軍はさらに紅海上空で巡航ミサイル２発、サウジ南部とリヤド地方で無人機（ドローン）３機を破壊したと発表した。攻撃主体は明らかにしなかった。

イエメン南部アデンの治安当局によると、空港の敷地内にミサイル２発が着弾した。死傷者は報告されていない。当局は親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃だと主張し、同空港への攻撃は１週間足らずで２回目だと説明した。

ヤンブーはサウジの重要な石油輸出拠点で、同国はここから紅海経由で原油を国際市場に送ることで、ホルムズ海峡を迂回できる。

サウジの民間防衛当局は１７日未明、イエメン国境に近い南西部アブハに警報を出し、その後解除した。これに先立ち、ジザン地方と南西部のハミースムシャイトにも警報を出していた。

フーシ派系メディアは１７日未明、イエメン北西部サアダの東で攻撃があったと報じた。サウジ主導の連合軍は、同地域で弾道ミサイル発射装置２基を破壊したと発表した。

items.title: Beijing Seeks Tighter Grip on AI Exports Amid U.S. Rivalry
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Eduardo Baptista China proposed export controls on 23 AI technologies on Friday, including those involving models, agents, and computing clusters, in a move to limit transfers of tools it views as vital to national security and to counter geopolitical competition with Washington. The proposals …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Eduardo Baptista

China proposed export controls on 23 AI technologies on Friday, including those involving models, agents, and computing clusters, in a move to limit transfers of tools it views as vital to national security and to counter geopolitical competition with Washington.

The proposals cover overseas deployment of AI models containing restricted technology, but exclude access through application programming interfaces (APIs), websites, apps and software-as-a-service platforms, China’s commerce ministry said.

The distinction could let Chinese AI developers such as DeepSeek and Alibaba keep expanding internationally while giving Beijing greater oversight of transfers of sensitive AI technology abroad.

Chinese AI models have gained ground abroad thanks to lower prices and improving capabilities since DeepSeek’s R1 model emerged early last year, raising the stakes for Beijing as it decides how tightly to guard the sector.

Reuters reported in July that Chinese authorities had discussed with major technology companies, including Alibaba, ByteDance and Z.AI, potentially restricting overseas access to China’s most advanced AI models, including unreleased ones.

Preventing AI From Harming National Security

Frontier models like Anthropic’s Mythos have shown AI’s potential to turbocharge cyberattacks, worrying Beijing and prompting Chinese companies to develop their own versions.

Washington’s export controls on China’s access to cutting-edge American AI chips needed to train frontier models have so far helped keep US firms Anthropic and OpenAI in the lead, though Chinese rivals are finding workarounds to narrow the gap.

While both countries strive to lead in AI, some bilateral efforts are underway to address the existential risks the technology poses. The two powers have agreed to keep humans in control of nuclear-weapons decisions and last month set up a dialogue and an incident-communications channel for advanced AI.

The commerce ministry said on Friday the controls were partly intended to prevent misuse of AI technologies, including systems capable of autonomously generating and modifying malicious software that could threaten critical infrastructure and national security.

It said most AI technologies would remain freely exportable, with simplified licensing for open-source technology exports and Chinese companies operating their own computing centers overseas. Technology already in the public domain through open-source releases or academic papers would be outside the proposed controls.

Broader Revision

The proposals form part of a broader revision of China’s technology export catalog, covering 40 technologies across AI, biotechnology and solar power.

The proposals also include a ban on transferring intellectual property ownership for some novel cell and gene therapies and small interfering RNA (siRNA) technologies.

Exporters must register certain overseas technology transfers from Friday, pending final rules after public consultation on the proposals closes November 15.

items.title: サッカー＝チェルシー主将ジェームズ、膝の手術で数週間離脱
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　１６日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ロンドン　１６日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、チェルシーを率いるシャビアロンソ監督は１６日、練習中に膝を負傷した同クラブの主将リース・ジェームズ（２６）が軽度の手術を受け、戦列を離れると明かした。

シャビアロンソ監督は１７日に敵地で行われるプレミアリーグのエバートン戦に向けた記者会見で、「彼は代表戦期間明けから良いスタートを切りたがっていたが、直近の練習で負傷してしまった。手術は無事に成功した。具体的な復帰時期は定めていないが、数週間の離脱となるだろう」と述べた。

英メディアによれば、離脱期間は３カ月となる見込み。ジェームズはここ数シーズンにわたって度重なるけがに悩まされており、直近の代表戦でも負傷のためイングランド代表メンバーから外れていた。

items.title: サッカー＝ウルグアイで「電子カード」試験導入、警告をデジタル表示
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのウルグアイ・カップ（杯）で１５日、審判員が従来のイエローカードに代わり、スマートフォンほどの大きさの電子機器を使って選手に警告を与える試みが行われた。審判業務のデジタル化を目指す取り組みの一環。

審判員が電子機器を使用すると、警告などの懲戒処分がデジタルで記録される。機器は試合中の出来事を時刻とともに記録する仕組みで、ウルグアイ・サッカー協会が使用する「ＣＯＭＥＴ」と呼ばれるシステムへの公式記録の提出を効率化する狙いがある。

実際に使用した審判員は、機器は使いやすくてソフトウエアの反応も速かったと評価。「素早くカードを提示する際の魔法のような魅力は少し失われるが、特に事務作業の面で大いに役立つと思う」と述べた。

ただ、試験運用では視認性の問題も浮上した。以前の試験では日光で画面が見えにくくなり中止されたほか、１５日の試合でも観客やテレビ視聴者が判定を識別しにくい場面があった。開発側は機器の周囲にＬＥＤ照明を取り付けるなど、色の識別を容易にする改良を検討している。

items.title: テニス＝ジョコビッチ、スイス室内に15年ぶり参戦
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスで四大大会通算２４勝を誇るノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）が２６日開幕のスイス室内（バーゼル）に主催者推薦で出場することが１６日、決まった。同大会への出場は２０１１年以来１５年ぶりで、４度目となる。

３９歳のジョコビッチは今季、１０月の中国オープンで自身が持つ大会最多優勝記録を更新する７度目のタイトルを獲得した一方、マスターズ上海大会では２回戦でフベルト・フルカチュ（ポーランド）に敗れるなど好不調の波がある。全米オープンでは四大大会で０６年全豪オープン以来となる初戦敗退を喫した。

ジョコビッチは上海大会で敗退した後、今季残りは１１月２─８日のパリ・マスターズと年間成績上位選手によるＡＴＰファイナルにのみ出場する予定だと語っていた。

ジョコビッチは現在、ＡＴＰファイナル出場権を争う年間ポイントランキングで１１位。世界ランキング１位のヤニク・シナー（イタリア）が長引く膝の負傷で今季残りの欠場を決めたため、１７回目の出場を果たすには年間９位以内に入る必要がある。

items.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、メドベージェフとホダルが4強
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［上海　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［上海　１６日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのマスターズ上海大会は１６日、シングルス準々決勝を行い、ロシア出身で第５シードのダニル・メドベージェフが第１５シードのトミー・ポール（米国）を６─３、１─６、６─３で下し、準決勝に進出した。

元世界ランキング１位のメドベージェフは１６本のサービスエース、３１本のウィナーを記録。ツアー通算７０回目の準決勝進出を決めた。

２０１９年大会覇者のメドベージェフは今大会で勝ち残っている唯一の歴代優勝者。準決勝では第１２シードのラファエル・ホダル（スペイン）と初対戦する。

２０歳のホダルは第２０シードのカスパー・ルード（ノルウェー）を４─６、６─４、６─３で破り、大会史上最年少の４強入りを果たした。今大会初出場のホダルは４試合連続で第１セットを落としてからの逆転勝利となった。

items.title: サッカー＝レアルがリーグ会長の辞任要求、ナチス宣伝手法との比較に反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マドリード　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マドリード　１６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部レアル・マドリードは１６日、同リーグのハビエル・テバス会長がクラブ経営陣の言動をナチスの宣伝手法に例えたことを受け、同会長の辞任を要求した。

テバス会長は１６日、自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）で、「レアル・マドリードの経営陣は代弁者たちのオーケストラを指揮しており、レアル・マドリードＴＶがそれを主導している」と記した。これは、テバス会長とリーグがレアル・マドリードの利益に反する行動を取っていると指摘した２人のジャーナリストの記事に対する反応だった。

さらに同会長は「彼らのやり方はいつも同じだ。自分たちに都合の良いプレー場面を選び出し、不満を繰り返し、疑念をあおり、敵を指弾する。この手法はナチス・ドイツのゲッベルスが用いた宣伝手法の仕組みをほうふつとさせる」とし、「私が比較したのはあくまで宣伝手法であり、イデオロギーやレアル・マドリードのファンのことではない」と付け加えた。

これに対し、レアル・マドリードは声明で、テバス会長がナチスの宣伝手法を引き合いに出したことは「容認し難く、極めて重大な事態だ」と批判した。「クラブ、経営陣、テレビ局の信用を傷つけようとした。テバス氏の度重なる言動は組織のトップとしての責任を果たす上で不可欠な中立性、敬意、公平性の欠如を示している」とした上で、リーグ会長とスペイン・サッカー連盟副会長を辞任するよう求めた。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャースのロハスが現役引退、ワールドシリーズ2回制覇
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースに所属するミゲル・ロハス内野手（３７）が１５日、現役引退を表明した。

ドジャースは同日、ナ・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）第４戦でブルワーズに４─６で敗れ、４連敗で敗退。ワールドシリーズ３連覇の夢が絶たれた試合後、ロハスはチームメートに引退を伝えた。

ロハスは「これで終わりだ。人生、キャリア、野球界での次のステップに進む。今日が選手としてこのユニフォームとスパイクを身に着ける最後の日だった。今はスパイクを脱ぐのが本当につらい」と声を詰まらせながら語った。

ベネズエラ出身のロハスは２０１４年にドジャースでメジャーデビューし、その後マーリンズで８シーズンを過ごし、２３年にドジャースに復帰。２４、２５年のワールドシリーズ連覇を経験した。ＭＬＢ通算１３シーズンで１４０１試合に出場し、打率２割６分、１０４８安打、６１本塁打、３８６打点、６８盗塁を記録した。

２５年のワールドシリーズでは、ブルージェイズとの第７戦で九回に同点本塁打を放ち、優勝に大きく貢献。ドジャース復帰後の４シーズンでは４４６試合に出場し、打率２割６分を記録した。

引退後はドジャースの選手育成部門に加わる予定で、具体的な役職は今後決まる。

items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１６日、１試合を行い、堂安律と小杉啓太がフル出場したアイントラハト・フランクフルトがホームでケルンを１─０で下した。

前半３分に堂安、同９分に小杉がチャンスに絡んだフランクフルトだが、０─０のまま後半へ。それでも、迎えた後半３２分にペナルティーエリア右でパスを受けたユネス・エブヌタリブがシュートを沈め、これを決勝点とした。

フランクフルトは３試合ぶりの勝利。勝ち点８とし、暫定８位に順位を上げた。

items.title: ゴルフ＝原と竹田が首位と3打差の4位、ビュイックＬＰＧＡ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのビュイックＬＰＧＡは１６日、中国・上海の佘山国際ＧＣ（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、原英莉花と竹田麗央が通算３アンダーの４位で並び、首位と３打差につけた。

前日７位の原は５バーディー、５ボギーの７２で回り、３位スタートの竹田は３バーディー、４ボギーの７３とスコアを１つ落とし、原と同じ通算１４１となった。

１２位で出た勝みなみは７８と崩れ、通算４オーバーの３０位に後退。吉田優利は４０位、西郷真央は５１位となった。

前日首位のチェ・ヘジン（韓国）は７４とスコアを２つ落としたものの、通算６アンダーの１３８で単独首位を維持。グレース・キム（オーストラリア）が７２、エイミー・ヤン（韓国）が７１で回り、ともに通算４アンダーの２位につけた。

items.title: サッカー＝上田、ＡＦＣ最優秀国際選手の候補入り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１６日　ロイター］ - アジア・サッカー連盟（ＡＦＣ）は１６日、２０２６年の年間表彰候補者を発表し、男子の最優秀国際選手賞で日本代表ＦＷ上田綺世（リール）が名を連ねた。

上田は昨季、オランダ１部フェイエノールトで得点王に輝き、今夏のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米大会でも２得点を記録。韓国代表の黄仁範、前回受賞者の李康仁と共にノミネートされた。

女子の最優秀国際選手賞には長谷川唯が３年連続で候補入り。オーストラリア代表のアランナ・ケネディ、ケイトリン・フォードと選ばれた。

男子の年間最優秀監督賞には、Ｊ１町田の黒田剛監督とＵ─１７（１７歳以下）女子日本代表の白井貞義監督が入った。

男子の年間最優秀若手選手賞では、北原槙、市原吏音、佐藤龍之介の日本人３選手が候補を独占。女子では福島望愛が候補入りした。

表彰式は１１月１９日にタイの首都バンコクで開催され、計１９部門の受賞者が発表される。

Oct 16 : Anthropic has signed a lease with EverWind for data center capacity at Point Tupper, Nova Scotia, marking the Claude maker’s first data center agreement in Canada, a company executive said on Friday.
Here are some more details:
• Separately, EverWind unveiled plans to invest more than C$10 billion in the data center campus and wind power projects in Nova Scotia, calling it the largest privately funded investment in the province’s history.
• Data centers have faced criticism over their heavy power and water use and the strain they place on local infrastructure.

• Anthropic spent $7.33 billion on computing and infrastructure last year, a threefold surge from 2024.
• The company is preparing for a US IPO that could value it at more than $2 trillion, although New York City Comptroller Mark Levine has urged it to delay the offering over safety and governance concerns.

items.title: 海外勢の米国債保有、8月は9.33兆ドルに増加　英加がけん引
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - 米財務省が１６日発表した８月の対米証券投資統計によると、海外勢の米国債保有残高は９兆３３１０億ドルと、前月の９兆２４８０億ドルから増加した。２カ月連続の減少から増加に転じた。英国とカナダの保有が増加をけん引した。

前年同月比では１％弱の増加にとどまった。  

日本の保有高は８月に１兆０６８０億ドルと、７月の１兆１０３０億ドルから３．２％減少し、４カ月連続の減少となった。ただ、日本は海外勢としては依然として米国債の最大保有国だ。保有額は２０２１年１１月に１兆３２５０億ドルでピークを付けた。

海外勢の保有額で２位の英国は、８月の保有高が前月の９９８３億ドルから１．１％増の１兆００９０億ドルとなり、初めて１兆ドルの大台を突破した。

中国の保有高は５９０７億ドルと、７月の６１８０億ドルから２．４％減少し、２００８年８月以来の低水準となった。減少は３カ月連続となった。中国は海外勢の保有額で依然として３位だが、８月の保有額は前年比で約１６％減少した。

米国債は１０８９億ドルの買い越しとなった。７月は３６億ドルの売り越しだった。

米社債は４１６億ドルの買い越しとなり、前月の２６９億ドルから増加した。

対米証券投資は１９９８億ドルの買い越し。前月の８７４億ドルから増加した。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ソウル １７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル １７日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮の国営朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）は１７日、北朝鮮が１５日に新型魚雷兵器システムの水中実験を行い、技術的な改良を検証したと報じた。実験は成功し、同国の海軍力発展における重要な一歩を刻んだとしている。

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（16日）10年債利回り週間で大幅低下、ドル軟調　株反落
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測の後退に加え、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄主導の株安への懸念が引き続き重しになっている。    米国では今週発表された９月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）をが予想を上回って伸びたことなどで、一時的に利上げ観測が再燃。ただその後、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言で追加利上げを急がない姿勢が示されたことで、ドル相場に対する支援材料も薄れていた。    今週はこのほか、ＡＩ関連銘柄が大幅に下落。ＡＩ関連銘柄やサプライチェーン全体に資金を投じてきた投資家の間でデータセンター運営企業が債務返済に必要な利益を十分なタイミングで確保できるのか疑念が広がっていることが背景にあり、影響はドル相場にも波及している。
items.body:
＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測の後退に加え、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄主導の株安への懸念が引き続き重しになっている。    米国では今週発表された９月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）をが予想を上回って伸びたことなどで、一時的に利上げ観測が再燃。ただその後、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言で追加利上げを急がない姿勢が示されたことで、ドル相場に対する支援材料も薄れていた。    今週はこのほか、ＡＩ関連銘柄が大幅に下落。ＡＩ関連銘柄やサプライチェーン全体に資金を投じてきた投資家の間でデータセンター運営企業が債務返済に必要な利益を十分なタイミングで確保できるのか疑念が広がっていることが背景にあり、影響はドル相場にも波及している。    ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はバンコクで開かれた国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会で行った講演で、米経済の力強さについて楽観的な見方を示すとともに、エネルギーショックが続きインフレ抑制に向けた金融引き締めが行われる中でも、世界経済が持ちこたえていることに驚きを表明。ＦＲＢの金融政策については「予断を持たない」と述べるにとどめ、追加利上げの可能性について手掛かりは示さなかった。    ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、今月の会合で金利据え置きが決定される確率は８３％。１カ月前の４９％から大きく上昇した。    終盤の取引で、ドル／円は０．０８％安の１ドル＝１５８．１１円。日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に「かなり近づいている」と指摘する一方で、２％目標に到達したかの判断は２９日からの金融政策決定会合で「政策委員の間でしっかり議論して結論を出したい」と述べるにとどめた。    ユーロ／ドルは０．０８％高の１．１２２７ドル。    主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％安の１０１．８７。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　指標となる１０年債利回りが週間ベースで１年超ぶりの低下幅となる見通しとなった。足元の経済指標を見極める動きが見られる中、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の次回利上げは１２月まで見送られるとの見方が強まっている。    午後の取引で１０年債利回りは横ばいの５．０８７％。一時、５．１３３４％まで上昇していた。ただ、週間ベースでは、２０２５年８月１日終了週以来の低下幅となる見通しとなった。    この日発表の経済指標では、９月の米輸入物価指数は前年比で８．１％上昇と、２０２２年７月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。中東紛争が続く中、インフレ圧力が高まっていることを改めて示唆した。    ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長は１６日、バンコクで開かれた国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会で、金利決定については「予断を持たない」と表明。今月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げするか、据え置くかについては手掛かりを示さなかった。    市場ではＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで金利を据え置くとの見方が一段と強まり、ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場が織り込む据え置きの確率は約８３％、１２月の利上げ確率は約８８％となった。    ２年債利回りは３．２ｂｐ低下の４．７１９％。一時、４．７８３％まで上昇していた。    ３０年債利回りは０．５ｂｐ上昇の５．４３３％。一時、５．４６４％を付けていた。     ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３６．６ｂｐ。    物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、１０年物が２．３４７％となった。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　反落して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービス大手コアウィーブやブロードコムなどＡＩ関連のハイテク株が再び売られたほか、原油価格の急伸も重しとなった。    エヌビディアが出資するコアウィーブは１２％下落。直近５営業日の下げ幅は約２５％となった。同社の社債は今週、大きく売り込まれ、利回りは１５％を超えた。    ブロードコムは４．５％下落。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３．８％安となり、２００８年以来となる８営業日続落となった。    ナスダック総合は週前半からの下落幅を拡大した。多額の債務を抱えるＡＩインフラ企業が、借り入れコストの上昇が見込まれる中、債務返済に見合うだけの利益を期日までに計上できないのではないかとの懸念が圧迫した。     Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種のうち６つが上昇。エネルギーが２．４７％上昇でトップ、公益事業が１．４％上昇と続いた。    その他の個別銘柄では、電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは３．１％下落。同社は、ロケットのような推進装置（スラスター）を搭載した新デザインのスポーツカー「ロードスター」を公開し、２０２８年に生産を開始すると発表した。    動画配信大手ネットフリックスは２．８％下落。同社は、最高コンテンツ責任者として元ディズニー幹部のピーター・ライス氏を起用すると発表した。    来週からは第３・四半期決算シーズンが本格化し、テスラ、メタ・プラットフォームズ、プロクター・アンド・ギャンブルなどが決算を控える。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストは四半期利益がＡＩ関連の大型株にけん引され、平均で３０％超急増すると予想している。    Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種では値下がり銘柄数と値上がり銘柄数がほぼ拮抗した。    米取引所の合算出来高は１８６億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７７億株。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測が強まる中、金相場は小動きとなり、週間では下落の見通しとなった。中心限月１２月物の清算値は０．３％高の１オンス＝４１８１．１０ドル。金現物は、米東部時間午後２時７分（日本時間１７日午前３時７分）時点で０．１％安の１オンス＝４１６５．１２ドル。週間では０．７％下落した。

米卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）と消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回る伸びを示したことで、ＦＲＢによる年内追加利上げの可能性が意識されている。ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長は米経済の強さに楽観的な見方を示したものの、利上げ方針については明言しなかった。市場では今月の利上げは見送られるとの見方が大勢だが、１２月の利上げ確率は９０％とされている。 

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　大幅高となり、北海ブレントが一時１バレル＝１１０ドルと５月以来の高値を付けた。中東情勢の緊迫化で供給が一段と逼迫するとの懸念が広がったほか、ロシアからの世界市場向けディーゼル燃料の供給能力に不透明感が強まったことが背景。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．９４ドル（３．７％）高の１０９．８６ドルで、５月１９日以来の高値。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．４４ドル（３．５％）高の１０１．４１ドルで、９月１７日以来の高値となった。    今週に入ってブレントは４．９％、ＷＴＩは１０．４％、それぞれ上昇した。 

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

米卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）と消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回る伸びを示したことで、ＦＲＢによる年内追加利上げの可能性が意識されている。ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長は米経済の強さに楽観的な見方を示したものの、利上げ方針については明言しなかった。市場では今月の利上げは見送られるとの見方が大勢だが、１２月の利上げ確率は９０％とされている。

＜米原油先物＞　大幅高となり、北海ブレントが一時１バレル＝１１０ドルと５月以来の高値を付けた。中東情勢の緊迫化で供給が一段と逼迫するとの懸念が広がったほか、ロシアからの世界市場向けディーゼル燃料の供給能力に不透明感が強まったことが背景。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．９４ドル（３．７％）高の１０９．８６ドルで、５月１９日以来の高値。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．４４ドル（３．５％）高の１０１．４１ドルで、９月１７日以来の高値となった。    今週に入ってブレントは４．９％、ＷＴＩは１０．４％、それぞれ上昇した。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝反落、ＡＩ関連株の売り継続　コアウィーブ12％安
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Noel Randewich

[１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Noel Randewich

[１６日　ロイター] - 米国株式市場は反落して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービス大手コアウィーブやブロードコムなどＡＩ関連のハイテク株が再び売られたほか、原油価格の急伸も重しとなった。

エヌビディアが出資するコアウィーブは１２％下落。直近５営業日の下げ幅は約２５％となった。同社の社債は今週、大きく売り込まれ、利回りは１５％を超えた。

ブロードコムは４．５％下落。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３．８％安となり、２００８年以来となる８営業日続落となった。

ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのシニア投資ストラテジスト、ロブ・ハワース氏は「市場には幾分の警戒感がある。とりわけ原油高は、株式の株価収益率（ＰＥＲ）を圧迫しがちだ。投資家は週末に向けてリスクを取るよりも慎重な姿勢を取ろうとしている」と述べた。

ナスダック総合は週前半からの下落幅を拡大した。多額の債務を抱えるＡＩインフラ企業が、借り入れコストの上昇が見込まれる中、債務返済に見合うだけの利益を期日までに計上できないのではないかとの懸念が圧迫した。 

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種のうち６つが上昇。エネルギーが２．４７％上昇でトップ、公益事業が１．４％上昇と続いた。

その他の個別銘柄では、電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは３．１％下落。同社は、ロケットのような推進装置（スラスター）を搭載した新デザインのスポーツカー「ロードスター」を公開し、２０２８年に生産を開始すると発表した。

動画配信大手ネットフリックスは２．８％下落。同社は、最高コンテンツ責任者として元ディズニー幹部のピーター・ライス氏を起用すると発表した。

来週からは第３・四半期決算シーズンが本格化し、テスラ、メタ・プラットフォームズ、プロクター・アンド・ギャンブルなどが決算を控える。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストは四半期利益がＡＩ関連の大型株にけん引され、平均で３０％超急増すると予想している。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種では値下がり銘柄数と値上がり銘柄数がほぼ拮抗した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８６億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７７億株。

FAST

Oct 16 : SoftBank Group is considering an acquisition of Allied Universal in a deal that could value the US security services provider at about $18 billion, a source familiar with the matter said on Friday.
• Allied Universal provides security staffing for businesses, venues and major events, and has a growing presence in the data center industry, supporting both development and operation of facilities
• The potential acquisition would complement SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son's increasing focus on AI, as he is exploring the use of AI-powered robots across industries, and looking to strengthen the infrastructure needed to support the technology
• With Allied, SoftBank would look to eventually replace some staff with robots for certain security tasks, though the deployment of humanoid security workers is likely to take longer.

• Deliberations are preliminary and no final decisions have been made, including on the potential price, Bloomberg News first reported the news
• SoftBank declined to comment on the report, while Allied Universal did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment
• SoftBank is widely known for making large technology investments through its Vision Fund. It was an early investor in Alibaba, owns a majority stake in Arm, and was a major backer of the office-sharing startup WeWork
• The deal builds on SoftBank's broader push into robotics and automation, following its agreement last year to acquire swiss engineering group ABB's robotics business for $5.4 billion

items.title: トランプ氏、スターリンク巡る責任否定　 ゼレンスキー氏との関係「良好」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は１６日、ウクライナ軍が使う米スペースＸ＜SPCX.O＞の衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の利用制限が伝えらられたことについて、自身と同社を率いるイーロン・マスク氏のいずれにも責任はないとの認識を示した。

また、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と自身の関係は良好だと述べた。

スターリンクを巡っては、ウクライナ軍の司令部との通信が途絶したほか、接続速度も低下したと伝えられている。ロイターは１５日、ホワイトハウスがスターリンクの軍事向けサービス「スターシールド」のサービス縮小を承認したと報じていた。

トランプ氏は記者団に対し、ウクライナのスターリンクを巡る件について自身とマスク氏のいずれも責任はないとの認識を表明。ウクライナによるスターシールドへのアクセス制限については、米国が課したものではないと述べた。

トランプ氏は１５日放映のニュースマックスのインタビューで、ゼレンスキー氏とロシアのプーチン大統領が互いを憎んでいることが戦争終結を難しくしているとの見方を改めて表明。「私はゼレンスキー氏をあまり好んでいない」とした上で「両者とも終結を望んでいると思うが、私はプーチン氏よりもゼレンスキー氏の方が交渉しにくいと感じている」と述べていた。

items.title: Aluminum heads for surplus in 2027 as supply shock fades
items.author: Mining.com
items.creator: Mining.com
items.summary: Aluminium is expected to swing into a surplus in 2027, potentially of more than 1 million metric tons, as analysts eye a wave of new supply from Indonesia a
items.body: Aluminium is expected to swing into a surplus in 2027, potentially of more than 1 million metric tons, as analysts eye a wave of new supply from Indonesia and a recovery in flows from Gulf smelters. Expectations for a supply bump have already helped push prices of the metal used in transport and packaging below $3,000 a ton this week to their lowest since December, after they hit four-year highs in June on trade disruptions from the Iran war and dwindling inventories. “We expect a substantial rebound in Middle East supply, with output rising to 6.4 million tons from 4.8 million tons this year,” Ross Strachan, head of aluminium raw materials at CRU, said. The Middle East, which accounts for around 9% of global primary aluminium capacity, has seen shipments severely disrupted by the Iran war. CRU sees a 1.4 million-ton surplus next year, compared to a deficit of 711,000 tons this year. The world produced 73.8 million tons of primary aluminum in 2025. In Indonesia, where projects led by Chinese investors — unable to expand in their home market due to a capacity ceiling — are ramping up, CRU expects output to more than double from this year to 3.2 million tons in 2027. Growing pains Other analysts assume lower surpluses, cautioning that extra supply will be hard-won. Uday Patel, senior research manager at Wood Mackenzie, projects oversupply of around 500,000 tons next year against a 900,000-ton deficit this year. Gulf smelters are recovering but have been forced to use alternative routes to get their metal to export markets, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz at great expense. “You could see a situation where you have a surplus but still elevated premiums and potentially prices,” Patel said. He sees around 1 million tons of additional production from Indonesia next year but points to “growing pains” in the country’s aluminium sector. “The smelters are being built quicker than the infrastructure,” he said, with ports and power supply struggling to keep up. Bank of America commodity strategist Michael Widmer notes that the market had previously expected Indonesia to produce more than 2 million tons of aluminium this year, whereas the actual number could be closer to 1.2 million tons. “It’s coming, but slower than people thought,” said Widmer, who estimates 2.2 million tons of Indonesian supply next year — most of it in the second half — and a smaller surplus of 239,000 tons. (Reporting by Tom Daly; Editing by Jan Harvey)

items.title: 米財政赤字、26年度1.99兆ドルに拡大　5年ぶり高水準
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - 米財務省が１６日発表した２０２６会計年度（２０２５年１０月─２６年９月）の米連邦政府の財政赤字は、前年度比２１７０億ドル増の１兆９９００億ドルとなり、５年ぶりの高水準を記録した。関税の還付や、４０兆ドルを超える政府債務の利払い費が過去最高となったことなどが赤字拡大につながった。

社会保障制度向け支出が引き続き増加したことや、国防費が４８０億ドル増加したことも赤字拡大の一因となった。 

２６年度はトランプ米大統領の２期目で初めて通年となる会計年度。２５年度の赤字は１兆７８００億ドルだった。２６年度の赤字は、新型コロナウイルス禍への対策支出で２兆７７００億ドルに膨らんだ２１年度以来の規模で、過去３番目の大きさとなった。

２６年度の歳入は過去最高の５兆４０００億ドルで、２５年度の５兆２４００億ドルから１６９０億ドル（３％）増加した。歳出も過去最高の７兆４０００億ドルとなり、前年度の７兆０１００億ドルから３８６０億ドル（６％）増えた。

債務の利払い費は１４４０億ドル（１２％）増の１兆３６００億ドルと、過去最高を記録した。歳出項目別では、社会保障と、高齢者向け公的医療保険「メディケア」・低所得者向け公的医療保険「メディケイド」の合計に次ぐ規模となった。米政府債務は約２カ月前に４０兆ドルを突破した。

関税の純収入が２２０億ドル減少したことも赤字拡大の要因となった。最高裁は２６年、トランプ氏が就任１年目に導入した関税の大部分を無効とする判断を下した。これを受けて同年中に１４５０億ドルの関税還付が行われ、関税の純収入は１１％減の約１７３０億ドルとなった。

２６年度の国防費は６％増の９１７０億ドルだった。財務省当局者は、この増加分のうちイラン戦争に起因する額は明確でないと述べた。 

財務省当局者は、２６年度の財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比を６．２％と推計したと述べたが、算出に用いたＧＤＰの推計値は明らかにしなかった。２５年度の実績は５．８％だった。

２６年度の最終月に当たる９月の財政収支は２７０億ドルの赤字。前年同月は１９８０億ドルの黒字だった。

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、ＦＲＢ金利据え置き観測強まる　ＡＩ株安も重し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測の後退に加え、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄主導の株安への懸念が引き続き重しになっている。

米国では今週発表された９月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）をが予想を上回って伸びたことなどで、一時的に利上げ観測が再燃。ただその後、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言で追加利上げを急がない姿勢が示されたことで、ドル相場に対する支援材料も薄れていた。

今週はこのほか、ＡＩ関連銘柄が大幅に下落。ＡＩ関連銘柄やサプライチェーン全体に資金を投じてきた投資家の間でデータセンター運営企業が債務返済に必要な利益を十分なタイミングで確保できるのか疑念が広がっていることが背景にあり、影響はドル相場にも波及している。

ストーンＸのグローバル市場調査責任者、マット・ウェラー氏は「今週、最も興味深いと感じたのはドル相場がＡＩ関連取引と極めて密接に連動したことだった」と指摘。「通常なら、ハイテク株が売られれば安全資産としてドルが買われる展開が予想される。実際、債券市場ではそうした安全資産買いの動きが一部見られたが、ドルはむしろ売られた」と述べた。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はバンコクで開かれた国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会で行った講演で、米経済の力強さについて楽観的な見方を示すとともに、エネルギーショックが続きインフレ抑制に向けた金融引き締めが行われる中でも、世界経済が持ちこたえていることに驚きを表明。ＦＲＢの金融政策については「予断を持たない」と述べるにとどめ、追加利上げの可能性について手掛かりは示さなかった。

ＢＮＹ（ニューヨーク）の米州担当マクロストラテジスト、ジョン・ベリス氏は「２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げについて、ＦＯＭＣ内で特に理事の間で十分な支持があるとは思えない」と指摘。「１２月の次回会合については結論はまだ出ていない。それまでに多くのことが起こり得る」と述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、今月の会合で金利据え置きが決定される確率は８３％。１カ月前の４９％から大きく上昇した。

終盤の取引で、ドル／円は０．０８％安の１ドル＝１５８．１１円。日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に「かなり近づいている」と指摘する一方で、２％目標に到達したかの判断は２９日からの金融政策決定会合で「政策委員の間でしっかり議論して結論を出したい」と述べるにとどめた。

ユーロ／ドルは０．０８％高の１．１２２７ドル。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％安の１０１．８７。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は０．４５％高。防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは２．６％、バブコック・インターナショナルは３．６％それぞれ上昇した。

通期利益見通しを引き上げた電子商取引（ＥＣ）大手ＴＨＧは１０．８％高だった。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続伸して取引を終えた。堅調な企業業績を受けて買い注文が優勢だった。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは２．０９％上昇した。

ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳのデータによると、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種の構成企業全体の２０２６年７─９月期の利益は、前年同期比２０．７％増と見込まれている。

堅調な受注が確認されたドイツの半導体製造装置メーカー、アイクストロンは前日比６．２％高。通期の利益率見通しを引き上げたドイツの風力タービンメーカー、ノルデックスは１２．３％高。一方、配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは１．８％安。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は０．０６％高。週間では３．３９％下落した。

食品・飲料株指数は前日比１．３７％高。ＪＰモルガンが投資判断を引き上げたスイスの食品大手ネスレは１．７％上昇した。

一方、ヘルスケア株指数は０．２５％安だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

域内国債利回りが横ばいで推移した。ただ、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業が巨額支出に見合うリターンを上げられるかどうかへの懸念から、国債には安全資産として買いが入っており、週間ベースでは低下の見通しとなった。

今週初め、ＡＩ関連投資に絡み債務が膨らんだ企業の株式・社債が大きく売られたことが、株式市場全般の重しとなり、投資家は国債に回帰した。世界の国債市場は週間ベースでは４カ月ぶりの大幅上昇に向かっており、ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の国債利回りは平均で８．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．２７３％となった。 

ソシエテ・ジェネラルのアナリストは「ＡＩブームを巡る懸念が国債の投資妙味を高めている」と指摘。ただ、「こうした局面は過去にもあった」とした上で、これがＡＩ投資に対する熱狂やサイクルの終わりを意味するとは思わないとの見方を示した。 

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇し、３．４２％前後で推移した。ただ、週間では約７ｂｐ低下した。

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは２ｂｐ低下の３．０６％となった。

ここ数週間で最も大きく売られてきたフランス１０年債利回りは４．７９％前後と横ばいで推移した。週間では７ｂｐ低下と、８月序盤以来の低下幅となる見通し。財政問題に対処する仏政府の能力を巡り、市場では根深い懸念が広がっている。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は約１３７ｂｐ。今月２日には約１６０ｂｐと１５年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

市場は、今月のＥＣＢ理事会で利上げが実施されるとの見方は織り込んでいないものの、１２月には１００％の確率で利上げが行われると予想。来年４月までに少なくとももう１回追加利上げに踏み切るとみている。

items.title: ローマ教皇、プーチン氏とウ占領地の人道支援協力で合意　入院中に電話会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joshua McElwee

[バチカン市国　１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Joshua McElwee

[バチカン市国　１６日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は、ローマ教皇レオ１４世が１６日の電話会談で、ロシア占領下にあるウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシキに緊急物資を搬入するための協力を求めたのに対し、協力することで合意したと伝えた。ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）が明らかにした。

教皇庁（バチカン）によると、教皇はプーチン氏に電話し、オレシキへの救援物資や食料の搬入を可能にするため停戦を要請するとともに、同地の人道状況について「深い懸念」を表明した。

クレムリンは声明で「町の住民の安全を確保し、必要な物資供給を組織するために必要な環境を整える取り組みを支援するというバチカンの意向を支持した」とした上で、「この件に関して協力することで合意した」と表明。ただ、停戦については言及しなかった。

教皇は１３日に肺がん切除の手術を受けた後、ローマのジェメッリ病院で療養中。バチカンは１６日、教皇の容体は着実に改善しており、仕事や通常の日常生活をこなせる状態にあると明らかにしていた。

items.title: U.S. Treasury Department’s investigation does not signal reduced bond issuance; U.S. Treasury yields rise as 10-year reclaims 5.12%
items.author: 华尔街见闻
items.creator: 华尔街见闻
items.summary: In a survey soliciting opinions from primary dealers, the Treasury Department asked about plans for repurchasing long-term government bonds, ways to enhance repo efficiency, the timing of short-term bond issuance, and prospects for the economy and financing, but did not directly address the issue of reducing long-term bond supply. Some investors had expected the Treasury to use this questionnaire to more clearly signal that it is considering scaling back the size of long-term bond auctions or even stopping the issuance of 20-year bonds, in response to the Trump administration's efforts to lower financing costs. The refinancing announcement to be released by the Treasury on November 4 has become the next observation point.
items.body: The latest primary dealer survey by the U.S. Treasury did not provide a clear signal that it will imminently cut the size of long-term Treasury auctions, disappointing investors who were betting on government action to suppress long-term interest rates. As a result, U.S. Treasuries fell and yields generally rose. This survey is part of the Treasury's preparation for the quarterly refunding plan to be announced on November 4. The market had hoped to find clues from the questionnaire about whether Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen might adjust the size of long-term Treasury issuance, especially the much-discussed possibility of reducing or even halting the issuance of 20-year bonds. However, the Treasury only broadly asked what auction scale adjustments should be considered in the future, without explicitly suggesting that a supply cut for long-term debt is imminent. After the release of the Treasury's survey, U.S. Treasury yields rose across the board in the secondary market. The U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yield climbed back to 5.12%, approaching the day's pre-market high of 5.1315%, with the intraday gain expanding again to 6.5 basis points; the 20-year Treasury yield rose 5.4 basis points on the day, and the 30-year yield saw its intraday increase expand again to about 5 basis points. The 2-year yield erased its intraday decline and turned higher. Meanwhile, oil prices had already begun rising shortly before the survey was released, also adding upward pressure to U.S. Treasury yields. Therefore, Friday's yield rise reflected both disappointment that the Treasury failed to deliver a supply-reduction signal and the influence of changes in energy prices. What Did the Treasury Ask, and What Is the Market Waiting For? This time, the Treasury solicited opinions from primary dealers, focusing on what adjustments to Treasury auction sizes should be considered in the face of structural changes in investor demand, and with the expectation that medium-term demand may continue to evolve in the future. Such surveys are routine preparatory work for the Treasury’s quarterly refunding decisions, aimed at understanding the main dealers' assessments of government financing needs, investor demand, and market conditions, to inform the final determination of Treasury issuance scale and structure. The survey itself is not a funding plan, nor does it mean the Treasury has decided to adjust issuance sizes for any maturities. According to reports, this questionnaire also covered multiple debt management topics: Long-term Treasury Buyback Program: The Treasury asked whether expanding the size of long-term Treasury buybacks has improved market liquidity and trading operations; how larger buybacks would affect dealers' ability to fulfill client orders, and clients’ willingness to participate directly or indirectly in buybacks. Further Improving Buyback Efficiency: The Treasury solicited suggestions from dealers on what further adjustments could be made to the buyback program. T-Bills and Floating Rate Note Issuance Timing: The Treasury asked whether it should change the current practice of avoiding issuing T-bills and floating rate notes on FOMC rate decision days. Economic and Financing Outlook: Dealers also need to provide forecasts regarding the economy, fiscal and monetary policy, and the Treasury’s borrowing needs for the coming fiscal years. What really disappointed the market was that the Treasury did not directly address the issue of reducing long-term Treasury supply. Some investors had hoped that the Treasury would use this questionnaire to more clearly signal it is considering downsizing long-term bond auctions, or even halting 20-year bond issuance, in response to efforts (advocated by the Trump administration) to lower financing costs. Blake Gwinn, Head of U.S. Rates Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, said if the Treasury intended to send a signal or influence yields via the survey, it could have asked much more direct questions. He believes this survey conveyed no substantial signals; given that some investors expected significant adjustments such as discontinuing the 20-year bond, the outcome may have disappointed the market. 20-Year Bond in Focus, Wall Street Bets on Treasury Adjusting Issuance Structure The market is extremely sensitive to this survey, mainly because long-term Treasury yields have been high recently. With the persistent U.S. fiscal deficit and growing interest payments on existing debt, government financing needs are on the rise. Pressure from long-term Treasury supply has become a core concern for investors. According to Bloomberg, some Wall Street institutions previously bet that the Treasury might ease long-term bond supply pressure by adjusting issuance structure. The focus of discussion has especially been on the 20-year bond: whether the Treasury would cut its issuance size or even abolish this maturity outright. From a financing mechanism perspective, the Treasury must meet the government's overall borrowing needs but does not have to issue each maturity type in fixed proportions. If there is sufficient demand and market capacity for short-term instruments, in theory, the Treasury could boost short-term debt issuance and thus reduce supply pressures in the long-term bond market. However, adjusting maturity structure also changes the government’s future refinancing needs and cannot simply be interpreted as reducing total borrowing. Molly Brooks, U.S. Rates Strategist at TD Securities, said the Treasury’s questions are still too general and do not explicitly ask whether to reduce long-term bond supply, hence the disappointment in the market. She expects any adjustment to long-term bond auction sizes is unlikely before February 2027 at the earliest. This means the optimistic scenario that some investors had bet on—where the Treasury would announce cuts to long-term issuance, or even eliminate the 20-year bond, in the November quarterly refunding plan—may not materialize soon. The questionnaire did not provide a clear supply-reduction signal, nor does it rule out potential future adjustments. Issuance Signal Disappoints, Oil Price Surge Adds to Long-End Yield Pressure Beyond the Treasury’s survey, rising oil prices have also added upward pressure on Treasury yields. Higher energy prices could reignite inflation concerns and affect investors’ views of the future path of Fed interest rates. For longer-dated Treasuries, inflation expectations, future short-term rates, and required term premiums all influence yield pricing. This also explains why the market reaction was concentrated in long-dated Treasuries. Long-term bond prices are especially sensitive to changes in supply expectations: if investors were expecting the Treasury to reduce long-end issuance and such signals are missing, they may reassess both the amount of long-term bonds they must hold and the returns they demand for taking on interest rate risk. However, it would be wrong to attribute Friday’s rise in yields solely to the Treasury survey. Changes in oil prices were also highlighted as a driver in reports; the survey results merely fell short of the market’s hopes for a more proactive policy shift, and do not directly prove that the scale of future long-term Treasury issuance will remain unchanged. November 4 Refund Announcement Becomes the Next Focal Point The Treasury will announce the next quarterly refunding plan on November 4, at which point the market will be able to further assess the government's views on borrowing needs, issuance sizes for different maturities, and the specifics of buyback arrangements. The U.S. government faces persistent budget deficits, and interest on existing debt is also rising, which means the Treasury must strike a balance among financing costs, market demand, and the maturity structure of debt. Cutting long-term supply to lower long-end yields is one possible path the market is watching, but it is not without constraints. Before the formal announcement, dealer surveys are only market consultations and not policy commitments. The drop in long-end Treasury prices and renewed rise in yields on Friday reflected that the market was originally hoping for a more proactive supply-reduction signal from the Treasury, which was not sufficiently evident in the survey. Going forward, investors will continue to watch whether the Treasury adjusts its long-end issuance plans in the November refunding, and whether such moves can truly alleviate the supply pressure on long-term Treasuries.

items.title: ザカリア米大統領報道官「解任」、弁護士資格に疑問　トランプ氏「後任急がず」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Nandita Bose　Jasper Ward

［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Nandita Bose　Jasper Ward

［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ - 米ホワイトハウス当局者は１６日、ザカリア新大統領報道官が就任から１週間足らずで解任されたと明らかにした。ザカリア氏を巡っては弁護士資格を巡る疑問が浮上し、同氏は前日、司法試験に合格していないと認めていた。

ホワイトハウス当局者２人はロイターに対し、ザカリア氏は「解任された」とし、「報道官職を離れる方向で手続きが進められている」と明らかにした。これに先立ち、トランプ米大統領はザカリア氏に対し、世間の厳しい注目を受けたことを踏まえ、職務を再考するよう伝えたと述べていた。

ザカリア氏は１２日に大統領報道官に就任し、１３日にホワイトハウスで初めての記者会見を行ったばかり。ザカリア氏の退任により、トランプ大統領は１１月の中間選挙を２週間余り後に控えた重要な時期に、政権の実績を訴え、共和党の議会多数維持を後押しする政権の重要な「顔」を失うことになる。

トランプ氏はこの日、ＦＯＸニュースの電話インタビューに対し、新たな報道官の任命は急いでいないと述べた。

ロイターはザカリア氏のほか、ホワイトハウスに電子メールでコメントを求めたが、今のところ回答は得られていない。

ホワイトハウス当局者の話でザカリア氏の解任が伝わる前、トランプ大統領は記者団に対し「私はザカリア氏に『幸せでいる方がいいと思う。この仕事をしていて本当に幸せになれるか分からない。決して楽な仕事ではない』と言った」とし、「正直に言って、『私があなただったら考え直すだろう。よく考えてみるべきだ』と伝えた」と述べていた。

トランプ大統領は９日、８月に退任したレビット報道官の後任にザカリア氏を指名したと発表。ザカリア氏は、報道官就任について連絡を受けたのは７日で、９日に正式な打診を受けたとしている。１３日の記者会見ではわずか３人の記者の質問に答えただけで、１５分足らずで会見を終了した。

トランプ氏はザカリア氏の起用を発表した際、同氏を弁護士と紹介。ただその後、カリフォルニア州のペパーダイン大学ロースクールを卒業したザカリア氏が実際に司法試験に合格し、弁護士資格を持っているか疑問の声が上がっていた。ザカリア氏は１５日夜、ＦＯＸニュース番組のインタビューで、司法試験に合格していないと認めた。

ザカリア氏の米大統領報道官の在任期間としては史上最短だったとみられる。トランプ第１次政権でホワイトハウス広報部長（コミュニケーションズ・ディレクター）を１０日間務めたアンソニー・スカラムーチ氏は「記録は破られるためにある」とＸに投稿。同時に「私は他人の苦境を喜ぶつもりはない」とも記した。

Analysis:Why CoreWeave is in the crosshairs of the AI scare

Michael Intrator, Chief Executive Officer of CoreWeave Inc., attends an interview with CNBC on the floor at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, U.S., September 22, 2025. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo

LONDON/BENGALURU, Oct 16 : Loss-making and deeply indebted US cloud company CoreWeave became an easy target this week for investors concerned about an artificial intelligence bubble. Its selloff, though, has greater significance for markets than its size implies.
The slump in the shares and bonds of the $39 billion Nvidia-backed AI infrastructure company came after third-quarter reports from hyperscalers hinted at delays in data center projects and a slower pace of growth in capital expenditure.
Worried investors took aim at new-age AI-based cloud firms, or neoclouds, such as CoreWeave, conceivably the weakest links in the AI ecosystem because of how they borrow heavily to finance chips, land and energy for data centers which will yield income only in the future.
CoreWeave's shares dived more than 15 per cent this week while yields on its 2030 bonds jumped 500 basis points to near 16 per cent.

CoreWeave chief Mike Intrator told employees in a memo, seen by Reuters, markets can sometimes "misunderstand and act irrationally" and it has a strong pipeline of demand. The company did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment.
Investors focused instead on its $50 billion debt and the perils of being trapped in the middle of a circular financing arrangement between chipmakers such as Nvidia and clients such as Meta Platforms and OpenAI.
"The problem with this stuff is that we're talking about huge interconnectedness, not just circular financing but the fact that these assets are all held in the same places, in the same portfolios, by the same types of investors," said James Athey, fixed-income portfolio manager at Marlborough.
"And leverage is always that thing which turns a storm into a teacup into something more nefarious," he said, referring broadly to the AI jitters.
Companies such as CoreWeave, Nebius, Applied Digital, Iren, Lambda Labs, Crusoe and TeraWulf are building energy-intensive data centers they can eventually rent out to firms developing and running AI models. That calls for massive upfront investment and very little income until the leases begin.
CoreWeave has never turned a profit, according to data compiled by LSEG.
CoreWeave's CEO also said in the memo that its deal backlog more than covers its debt obligations. The company had a $104.2 billion revenue backlog at the end of the second quarter, followed by more than $25 billion in new commitments early in the third quarter.
But the New Jersey-based company is burning cash faster than investors like. In 2025, CoreWeave reported annual revenue of $5.1 billion and a net loss of $1.2 billion.
While revenue is expected to double this year, capital expenditure is estimated to be up fourfold to between $35 billion and $39 billion, leading to even more cash burn this year. News that Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock since the company's IPO in March last year, mostly under prearranged trading plans as per regulatory filings, has not helped.
"Clearly they will need a capital injection or a bailout. They are burning capital, and capital is no longer free," said Alberto Gallo, founder of hedge fund Andromeda Capital.
"You want to buy debt in businesses that have visible cash flow, typically as a bond investor, not someone that is doing capex, in the hope that there will be more capex needed in the future," he said. The firm holds bets against CoreWeave bonds.
DOUBTS APLENTY
CoreWeave is at the top of the 100-odd neoclouds that research firm Gartner Inc says are "the most exposed to the imbalance between revenue and capital spending" and need to soon earn returns to sustain operations.
Gartner expects that by 2030, 80 per cent of neocloud providers will cease independent operations.
"We are in a situation in which there are a lot of expectations on revenues and revenue growth, but this revenue growth is being fueled by the wrong type of capital, which is debt, not equity," said Tommaso Leodari, Dubai-based chief investment officer of hedge fund Index & Cie. The fund does not hold stakes in pure AI firms.
"In the specific case of CoreWeave, these guys are financing their entire business with debt. So if anything happens in the utilization of this particular asset or if there is a slowing down on the construction of these data centers, it will reflect in problems in repaying the debt."
A streak of warnings from AI hyperscalers such as Microsoft and Oracle Corp on delays in data center projects, power and component bottlenecks, a glut in high-end chips, alongside plans by giants such as Meta and Microsoft to launch their own chips to rival Nvidia's, have also stoked concerns about neoclouds.
The pace at which revenue is growing at AI giants such as OpenAI and Anthropic, while still fast, has also softened.
"Even at $10 billion revenue, CoreWeave is losing $2.5 billion, so there are no scale effects in the industry clear as yet," wrote Michael Frazis of Sydney-based Frazis Capital Partners.
CoreWeave has Nvidia's backing. The chip giant has agreed to buy unsold CoreWeave compute capacity through April 2032, guaranteeing it will have a buyer for capacity not sold to customers.
Ratings agencies have CoreWeave's debt marked as speculative grade, yet Sean Cray, vice president at Moody’s Ratings, pointed out the company does not speculatively purchase chips and has multiple avenues for financing.
Originally a bitcoin miner, CoreWeave has still been an easy mark for punters, and hedge funds have been buying its junk-rated bonds for the high yield. The cost of insuring its debt against default climbed to about 1,200 basis points this week, signalling severe distress.
"CoreWeave's credit selloff risks becoming a self-fulfilling prophecy," wrote Saurav Sen at research firm Gimme Credit. "The concern is less whether customers want the capacity than whether CoreWeave can afford to deliver it."

ＦＢＩとＣＩＳＡの警告によると、ハッカーはパスワードやその他の機密データを盗み出すための偽のテキストメッセージや電子メールを用いて、中間選挙を妨害しようとする恐れがあるという。 

警告では「選挙関係者や候補者、その政治組織は、悪意あるサイバー犯罪者にとって魅力的な標的となっている」と指摘した。

また、トランプ米大統領が変更を主張するＡＩの呼称である「スーパーインテリジェンス」（超知能、ＳＩ）により、ハッカーは不正な電子メールやテキストメッセージをより説得力のあるものに見せかけるよう巧妙化させていると述べた。

FAST

Oct 16 : CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock, mostly under prearranged trading plans, since the AI cloud company's IPO in March last year, according to regulatory filings.
The sales began about two months after the stock hit a record high in June 2025. The shares have tumbled since and were on track to lose about 24 per cent this week as investors worried about the Nvidia-backed company's heavy capital spending and the debt needed to fund it amid rising bets on interest-rate hikes.
CoreWeave did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Here are some more details:

• The sales totaled more than 10 million shares, according to the filings. As of Thursday's close, CoreWeave had a valuation of $38.44 billion.
• The sales were made by Intrator and affiliated entities such as Omnadora Capital, where Intrator serves as managing member, and two trusts.
• Most of these sales, excluding roughly $40 million, were made under prearranged trading plans that allow executives to sell shares on a preset schedule, and do not necessarily reflect management's view of the business.
• The roughly $40 million that was not part of prearranged plans was sell-to-cover sales, where shares were sold on the market to pay taxes on vested stock.
• The selling occurred as CoreWeave rapidly expanded its data-center footprint and increased spending on Nvidia chips to meet demand for AI computing, while building a revenue backlog of more than $129 billion.
• In August, the company raised its annual capital expenditure forecast to be between $35 billion and $39 billion.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Yuliia Dysa

［キーウ　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Yuliia Dysa

［キーウ　１６日　ロイター］ - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１６日、トランプ米大統領がロシアと結んだ軽油供給合意について、戦争を終わらせる意思を示さない侵略国に対する一段の制裁緩和に道を開くことになり、世界的なリスクにつながると警告した。

イラン戦争による燃料価格高騰の責任を、ロシアの製油所に対するウクライナ軍の攻撃に転嫁しようとするトランプ氏の姿勢も非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏は欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳会議出席のため訪問中のブリュッセルで記者団に対し、「こうした軽油取引や合意は受け入れられない。次はガス取引、ガスの後には他の分野でも制裁が解除されるだろう。いずれ銀行システムや個人、化学産業にまで及ぶことになる」と厳しい認識を示した。

トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表した。nL6N45V0Z6

ロシアが２０２２年にウクライナへの全面侵攻を開始して以来、ロシア産化石燃料には段階的に制裁が科されてきた。ウクライナ政府は同盟国に対し、こうした供給への依存を終わらせるよう繰り返し求めている。

items.title: ロシア、ウクライナ領内に「安保地帯」設置へ　交渉対象外＝プーチン氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ １６日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１６日、ウクライナとの国境沿いのウクライナ領内で「安全保障地帯」の設置を進めていると明らかにし、将来的にウクライナと交渉が行われた場合でも、この安全保障地帯は交渉の対象にしないと述べた。

プーチン氏はこの日、軍服姿でロシア軍統合部隊の指揮所を視察。安全保障地帯の設置は２０２４─２５年にウクライナ軍がロシア西部クルスク州に侵攻したことへの対応になると説明し、「ロシア軍には、ロシア領から敵を排除する任務に加え、隣接地域に安全保障地帯を設ける任務も与えられている。この任務は成功裏に遂行されている」と述べた。

その上で、安全保障地帯の設置は「将来にわたりロシアの国境地域の絶対的な安全を確保すること」が目的だとし、これをウクライナとの和平交渉の議題にする考えはないと語った。

また、ロシア軍はウクライナ東部ドネツク州の制圧を進めているものの、同州の約１０％をまだ掌握できていないとも述べた。

ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官によると、計画されている安全保障地帯の総延長は６６０キロ。このうち約７０％はロシアがすでに支配下に置いているとしている。

プーチン氏の発言はテレビ中継された。
